name: 欢迎来到对面
subtitle: 向右是人类本能，向左是唯一生路
trollQuote: 人类一进横版游戏就像被写了死循环一样往右冲——右边那排小花花和旗子是我专门摆出来钓鱼的，真终点一直在你屁股左上方呢！
hintSteps: 别信开局向右的路牌！右侧遍地骷髅花且尽头是假旗。
转身往左冲向紫色石墙——石墙上半截是无碰撞虚像假墙，跳起穿过即可踩上闪烁的隐形阶梯。
顺着左上方的隐形踏板一路登顶，无视吓唬人的路牌，直接触碰高台真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Instinct tells every human to run right—too bad the real goal has been floating above your left shoulder the whole time!
hintStepsEn: Ignore the right-pointing sign! The right path is a lethal flower field ending in a fake flag.
Turn left and leap through the upper half of the purple wall—it's a phantom wall hiding invisible stairs.
Climb the invisible steps to the upper-left ledge and grab the real golden flag!

name: 云朵不是平台
subtitle: 看起来软绵绵的白云，八成藏着白刀子
trollQuote: 谁规定天上的云朵一定是棉花糖？本关80%的云朵怀里都揣着匕首，每隔2秒还会因为憋不住笑抖一下！
hintSteps: 观察云朵动态：每隔片刻剧烈颤抖并探出寒光刀尖的是带刀黑云，切勿触碰！
只踩平静发光的安全蓝云跳至中段铜台，切莫乱顶铜台上方的诱饵问号砖。
前方悬浮板踩上片刻后会碎裂（随后自动充能重凝），不停顿连跳越过最后朵刀云夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Who said clouds are soft? 80% of these clouds hide kitchen knives and twitch every 2 seconds!
hintStepsEn: Watch the clouds closely: clouds that shudder and flash blades every moment are lethal!
Hop only on calm blue clouds to reach the middle deck, and ignore the bait question block above.
Dash nonstop across the hover-vanish pads and leap over the final blade cloud to reach the flag!

name: 指示牌研究所
subtitle: 连路牌都在谋杀你，字越正经心越脏
trollQuote: 写着『安全区』的牌子藏着刀，写着『顶问号送神装』的问号藏着怪，天上的牌子想砸扁你，连终点前的假旗后面都藏着猫腻！
hintSteps: 第一块路牌暗藏利刃必须跳过；第二块路牌头顶的问号砖会蹦出怪物，直接从底下走过。
靠近半空悬挂的路牌边缘引诱它坠落，迅速后撤躲开，再拿落地的路牌当垫脚石跳上高台。
在高台跳过红花与回城假旗，直接穿入右侧路牌后方的紫色虚像假墙摸到真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Every polite signpost here wants you dead—though a fallen sign makes a great stepping stool!
hintStepsEn: Jump over the first armed signpost, and walk straight under the monster-spawning question block.
Bait the hanging signpost into dropping, step back, then use the fallen sign as a stepping stone.
Hop past the flower and warp-trap flag, then walk right through the purple phantom wall to the goal!

name: 蘑菇田野游记
subtitle: 以毒攻毒！不喝口毒药你怎么知道解药有多猛
trollQuote: 看到终点前那排无缝红伞鹅膏菌了吗？硬跳绝对过不去，但先吃紫毒菇再踩中前方的绿色解毒底座，就能化身金身一路平推！
hintSteps: 开局连续跳过前两朵剧毒粉红鹅膏菌。
顶开中段问号砖，主动吃下弹出的紫色毒蘑菇进入中毒倒计时状态。
趁中毒状态踩上前方绿色解毒底座，瞬间化作百毒不侵金身，一路横冲趟平菌海夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Fight poison with poison! You cannot cross the mushroom sea without getting poisoned first.
hintStepsEn: Leap cleanly over the first two spotted amanita mushrooms.
Hit the middle question block and intentionally eat the purple poison mushroom.
Step onto the green antidote pad while poisoned to trigger golden invincibility and charge through!

name: 天上不会掉馅饼
subtitle: 导弹正面糊脸即死，但踩在导弹背上就是顺风车
trollQuote: 中间那么大个深渊，桥还是豆腐渣假平台！别傻乎乎去踩桥，先开枪把催命闹钟打爆，再跳到飞来的导弹背上搭顺风车过去！
hintSteps: 开局立刻按攻击键挥出能量子弹，击碎前方的金色闹钟彻底解除催命倒计时。
深渊中央的宽桥是全息假平台，踩上去必掉深渊，千万别走！
跳上铜色候车高台，等导弹从脚下飞出时落到平坦弹背上，搭顺风车直抵对岸夺旗！
nameEn: NO FREE PIE IN THE SKY
trollQuoteEn: A missile nose-cone kills instantly, but its back is a first-class ticket across the abyss!
hintStepsEn: Slash the golden alarm clock right away to cancel the countdown timer.
Do not trust the bridge in the chasm—it's a hollow hologram trap!
Wait safely on the copper ledge, hop onto the flat back of a passing missile, and surf across!

name: 假终点研究报告
subtitle: 三面旗帜两面坑，真旗还被恶魔刺包围
trollQuote: 左上旗把你送回老家，底下旗让你脚底抹油，右边真旗前面摆了地刺阵！去中间顶隐形砖拿个护盾硬闯吧少年！
hintSteps: 左上高台与中段低谷的两面旗帜全是假货（一个把你传回起点，一个原地假欢呼坑杀）。
在中段平地收尾处起跳顶出隐藏砖，拾取蓝色能量护盾。
护盾挡不住骷髅红花但能抵御地刺！跳过右岸红花后直接顶盾冲过地刺摸真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Three flags, two traps, and laser spikes guarding the real one!
hintStepsEn: Skip both the upper-left warp flag and the middle valley taunt flag—both are decoys.
Jump near the end of the starting deck to reveal a hidden block containing an Energy Shield.
Hop over the red flower, then let your shield absorb the red spikes right in front of the real flag!

name: 导弹运动学
subtitle: 脚下全是万丈深渊，唯有三层导弹流是你的垫脚石
trollQuote: 欢迎来到哥查德航空公司！中途记得看清楚空中微弱闪光的隐形砖——站在导弹上不跳起来躲，脑门会撞得稀碎哦！
hintSteps: 站在起点悬崖边，待第一枚导弹从脚下飞出时稳稳跳上弹背向右骑行。
途中遇到半空警戒方块阻拦时，起跳越过方块并顺势落向中段悬浮充能踏板。
从悬浮踏板跳上下方射出的第二枚接力导弹，一路滑翔至右岸终点台！
trollQuoteEn: No floor below—only twin streams of cruise missiles!
hintStepsEn: Wait on the starting cliff lip and hop onto the first missile's back as it launches below.
Jump over the mid-air hazard block and land on the glowing cyan hover-pad.
Drop onto the second relay missile launching beneath the hover-pad and ride it to the goal!

name: 时钟的真相
subtitle: 越显眼的时钟越要命，真正的神钟藏在角落装死
trollQuote: 开局只有8秒！你一枪打爆面前那个大金钟，时间直接3倍狂飙送你归西！回头看看左上角那个不起眼的齿轮钟吧！
hintSteps: 千万别打正前方的金色闹钟——击碎它会让倒计时以数倍速狂飙！
开局立刻转身跳上左后方的小铜台，发射子弹击碎左上角的金色齿轮时钟。
齿轮钟破碎会触发全场时间冻结！倒计时消失且整排骷髅红花化为冰雕失效，直接踩花过关！
trollQuoteEn: Shooting the shiny gold clock speeds up your doom—look behind you!
hintStepsEn: Never shoot the golden clock ahead—it wildly accelerates the countdown!
Turn around immediately, hop onto the left ledge, and shoot the golden gear clock.
Freezing time stops the timer and crystallizes every skull flower—stroll right over them to win!

name: 炸弹入门课
subtitle: 化学鬼才哥查德：毒药 + 食人花 = 破墙烈性炸弹
trollQuote: 面前一堵通天厚墙封死去路，跳到猴年马月也翻不过去！还记得化学老师教的吗？先喝毒药再摸红花，人体炼金术搓炸弹！
hintSteps: 先拾取地面的紫色毒蘑菇，让哥查德进入紫色剧毒缠身状态。
趁中毒未消退直接撞向骷髅红花——以毒攻毒不会受伤，反而会中和毒素炼成一颗破墙炸弹！
走近右侧高耸的铜色裂纹墙，按下投弹键轰塌巨墙即可夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Gotchard Chemistry: Internal Poison + Skull Flower = Wall-Busting Bomb!
hintStepsEn: Touch the purple poison mushroom first to enter the poisoned state.
While poisoned, touch the red skull flower to neutralize the toxin and brew a demolition bomb!
Toss the bomb at the tall cracked copper wall to blast it open and claim the flag!

name: 综合绞肉机
subtitle: 第一章毕业考：坠落路牌、导弹骑行、假旗与隐形真出口
trollQuote: 恭喜熬到第10关！要是这关你没死够5次就过，我把键盘吃下去——右边那面旗子当然是假的，真旗藏在右上角高空呢！
hintSteps: 先靠近半空悬挂的路牌引诱它坠地，后退躲避后再踩着路牌跳上中层候车台。
在候车台上等导弹从下方掠过，跳上导弹背部飞越下方密集的红花与巡逻怪。
底下那面旗是假货！乘导弹接近右侧高空青色浮台时向上起跳，登顶夺取真旗解锁章节CG！
trollQuoteEn: Chapter 1 Exam: Falling sign, missile surfing, fake floor flag, and an upper-right secret exit!
hintStepsEn: Bait the hanging signpost down, dodge back, then step on it to reach the middle boarding deck.
Hop onto a passing missile's back to soar safely above the flower bed and ground monster.
Ignore the fake flag below—leap up from the missile onto the high cyan platform for the true flag!

name: 护盾的边界
subtitle: 护盾只防正经伤害，防不住花朵、刀云和精神污染▲
trollQuote: 谁告诉你开了护盾就能横着走了？看到地上的▲和红花没？护盾表示：『这玩意儿太脏了，你自己扛吧，告辞！』
hintSteps: 在起点前方半空顶出隐藏砖拿到能量护盾。
牢记护盾法则：骷髅花与便便无视护盾必须跳过，唯独红色激光地刺可用护盾硬抗通过！
后半程先吃毒蘑菇再摸骷髅花炼成炸弹，炸穿挡路裂纹高墙即可夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Read the fine print: Shields block monsters & spikes, NEVER flowers or poop!
hintStepsEn: Reveal the hidden block near the start to equip an Energy Shield.
Jump over both the skull flower and poop (shields don't block them!), and use your shield on the spikes.
Combine the poison mushroom and flower ahead into a bomb to breach the final wall!

name: 管道迷宫
subtitle: 不是所有马里奥水管都通向奖励房，有的直接通向火葬场
trollQuote: 1号管和2号管搁那儿无限鬼打墙，3号管直接把你空投进粪坑！看看右边那堵写着『此路不通』的墙，撞一下试试？
hintSteps: 地面前两根绿色传送管是互相死循环的迷魂阵，千万别按向下键钻进去！
一路往右走过假路牌，直接撞向路牌身后的高大紫色石墙。
那堵紫墙是无碰撞虚像假墙！穿墙后钻入隐藏的第三根真管道，直接跃迁至高台终点！
trollQuoteEn: Pipes 1 and 2 loop forever—the real pipe hides behind a lie!
hintStepsEn: Skip the first two green pipes—they only loop infinitely back and forth!
Walk past the lying signpost and charge straight into the tall purple wall.
Pass through the phantom wall and enter the hidden pipe behind it to warp to the goal ledge!

name: 金币陷阱博物馆
subtitle: 贪财是万恶之源，顺着金币跳的人坟头草都两米高了
trollQuote: 看到那条美妙的抛物线金币彩虹桥了吗？顺着金币跳，落点正好是一坨热乎的▲和万丈深渊！
hintSteps: 空中排成弧线的金币是坠渊诱饵，顺着金币跳必落进对岸便便陷阱！
在深渊边缘起跳踩出两块闪烁的隐形踏板，稳稳跨过裂谷并跳过岸边便便。
切勿在奸商黑店掏钱购物！踩黑店左上方隐形砖跃上二楼天台，穿过紫色假墙夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Greed kills: following the rainbow coin arc drops you straight into poop!
hintStepsEn: Don't follow the coin arc—it baits you straight into the chasm trap!
Reveal the two invisible stepping blocks across the gap and hop over the poop on landing.
Never buy from the goblin shop! Climb the hidden block onto the upper roof and pass the phantom wall!

name: 二段跳的代价
subtitle: 给你二段跳不是让你爽跳的，跳太高天灵盖给你削平
trollQuote: 全图天花板都装了激光剃头刀！二段跳如果在最高点按出来，正好把脑袋送进刀片里——要在下落到贴近坑面时再按第二跳！
hintSteps: 拾取起点前方的金色弹簧鞋解锁二段跳，但头顶整排布满了倒挂激光刺！
切忌快速连按两下高跳撞刺：先小跳或走下悬崖边缘，待下落至半空低位时再点二段跳。
用这种『下坠接平跳』的低空滑跃技巧连跨两道深渊，稳稳落至右岸夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Double-jumping at peak height sends your skull into ceiling lasers!
hintStepsEn: Grab the spring icon for Double Jump, but watch the ceiling spikes stretching overhead!
Never mash double-jump high: drop off the ledge or hop lightly first, then trigger your second jump low.
Skim low across both chasms beneath the ceiling spikes to reach the goal!

name: 商店的秘密
subtitle: 奸商哥布林挥泪大甩卖：买一送一（送你去投胎）
trollQuote: 地上白送你10枚金币，奸商正好卖10金币的『秒过神旗』——天下哪有这种好事？不买立省100%，直接穿墙端了他老窝！
hintSteps: 地上一字排开的免费金币全是奸商诱饵——去商店按交互键买货会当场引爆自毁！
捡不捡金币都无所谓，直接无视奸商往右穿入青色虚像假墙。
穿墙后踩地面弹簧高高跃起，空中微调避开带刀乌云，落上二楼铜台夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Goblin Special Offer: Buy 1 Instant-Win Flag, Get 1 Instant Explosion Free!
hintStepsEn: Those free coins are bait for the shady merchant—buying anything triggers an instant explosion!
Walk right past the shop and phase straight through the cyan phantom wall.
Bounce off the spring behind the wall, steer clear of the blade cloud, and land by the flag!

name: 跟随者的困境
subtitle: 子弹打不死的牛皮糖恶魔怪，只能用智商把它骗进沟里
trollQuote: 这只紫皮恶魔怪全身防弹，你开枪打它等于给它挠痒痒！而且终点前有个必须踩机关才能开的大门——不把怪物推进坑里献祭门可不开哦！
hintSteps: 前方的地面小恶魔自带防弹外壳，普通能量子弹打不死它且会一路紧追。
迎面勾引小恶魔追向中段断崖，看准时机起跳跨过深坑——小恶魔会自己刹不住车掉坑摔死！
登岸后稳稳跳过地面两处便便路障，轻松触碰终点真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Bullets only tickle the purple imp—gravity is your weapon!
hintStepsEn: The ground imp is bulletproof and relentlessly chases you.
Lure it toward the central pit and leap across—the imp will charge straight into the abyss!
Hop cleanly over the two poop hazards on the far bank to claim victory!

name: 材料第一课
subtitle: 没有三颗宝石当彩礼，傲娇公主连正眼都不看你
trollQuote: 直接跑去摸旗子？没门！公主就堵在旗子前面，少一颗宝石她都嫌你穷酸不放行！
hintSteps: 终点旗被皇家封印锁死，必须集齐红、绿、蓝三颗宝石献给公主才会解封。
踩起点弹簧摘取高空红宝石；再跳上飞来的导弹背部顺路摘下深渊上空的绿宝石。
到右岸顶开问号砖拿到蓝宝石，走近公主自动献宝解封旗帜！
trollQuoteEn: No 3 gems, no flag—the picky princess won't budge for broke heroes!
hintStepsEn: The goal flag is sealed until you bring all three gems (Red, Green, Blue) to the Princess.
Use the spring to snag the Red Gem, then surf a missile across the gap to grab the Green Gem.
Hit the question block on the far bank for the Blue Gem and approach the Princess to unlock the flag!

name: 子弹强化实验
subtitle: 强化火焰巨弹威力无穷——反弹回来糊自己脸上也一样疼！
trollQuote: 拿了强化大宝剑，射出的火焰弹能轰碎紫墙，但前面立着一块镜面反弹墙！站地上瞎开枪，一秒钟体验什么叫『我杀我自己』！
hintSteps: 顶开问号砖升级烈焰强化弹——它能轰碎裂纹墙，但射中青色镜面墙会超速反弹回杀自己！
千万别在一楼对着镜面墙开火！先踩铜色小踏板翻越镜面墙落到其背后。
背对镜面朝右侧裂纹高墙发射烈焰强化弹轰开门扉，跳过小坑夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Upgraded fireballs shatter cracked walls—and bounce off mirrors into your own face!
hintStepsEn: Hit the question block for Flame Wave—it breaks cracked walls, but mirrors reflect it lethally!
Never shoot facing the cyan mirror! Use the copper step to hop safely over the mirror first.
Once past the mirror, fire right to shatter the cracked wall and leap to the goal!

name: 飞行迷途
subtitle: 给你一对天使翅膀，上下全是刀山火海，考科目二呢！
trollQuote: 拿到翅膀别猛按跳跃键往天上蹿！头顶是激光刺，脚下也是激光刺，中间那块漂亮的平台还是漏底假货！
hintSteps: 拾取起点的蓝色赛博飞翼后，在空中每次点按跳跃键都能振翅拉升高度。
上下皆有密集尖刺夹击，保持有节奏地点按跳跃，在通道正中央高度平稳巡航。
海峡中途的悬浮板是无碰撞假平台，切勿落脚，一口气飞抵右岸安全台夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Wings unlocked—welcome to Flappy Gotchard between floor and ceiling lasers!
hintStepsEn: Grab the Cyber Wings to flap upward anytime in mid-air by tapping Jump.
Tap rhythmically to cruise through the middle of the spike tunnel—neither too high nor too low.
Ignore the fake hologram platform midway and fly all the way to the far landing deck!

name: 中期综合地狱
subtitle: 第二章毕业考：护盾、管道、导弹摘星、强化弹与公主彩礼大乱斗
trollQuote: 第二章学到的本事全得交出来！记住：镜面墙别正面射，▲别用护盾踩，两颗宝石全到手再去哄公主开心！
hintSteps: 跳过地面便便后钻入绿色传送管进入导弹峡谷。
乘导弹飞越峡谷顺手摘下高空红宝石；登岸后先顶问号砖升级烈焰强化弹。
踩青色踏板翻过镜面反弹墙，轰碎右侧裂纹门取出蓝宝石，献给公主即可夺旗欣赏第二章CG！
trollQuoteEn: Chapter 2 Finale: Pipes, missile gem-hunting, mirror walls, and royal tribute!
hintStepsEn: Hop over the poop and warp through the green pipe into the missile canyon.
Surf a missile to snag the high Red Gem, then hit the question block on landing for Flame Wave.
Vault over the mirror wall, blast the cracked door for the Blue Gem, and deliver both to the Princess!

name: 解毒剂的逻辑
subtitle: 喝下翠绿解毒神水后的5秒强化窗口，剧毒杀手全变神装！
trollQuote: 平时摸花必死、摸鹅膏菌必死；但只要先中毒再喝解毒药开启『解毒强化窗口』，花会变成护盾，鹅膏菌会变成破墙炸弹！
hintSteps: 先吃地面毒蘑菇，紧接着顶出上方隐藏砖服下绿色解毒药剂，开启全身泛绿光的百毒转化期！
趁绿光未散：先撞骷髅红花自动凝成护盾硬闯地刺阵，再撞粉红鹅膏菌将其炼成破墙炸弹！
将炼出的炸弹投向右侧高墙轰开通路，直取终点真旗！
trollQuoteEn: During the 7s Antidote Buff window, deadly flora transform into gear!
hintStepsEn: Touch the poison mushroom, then immediately hit the hidden block above for the Green Antidote aura!
While glowing green, touch the skull flower to gain a Shield for the spikes, then touch the amanita to brew a Bomb!
Use your newly brewed bomb to blast down the tall wall blocking the flag!

name: 隐形砖超密集
subtitle: 眼见皆为虚妄：所有看得见的桥都是假的，看不见的空气才是路
trollQuote: 这关专治近视眼和老实人——但凡你能用肉眼看到的漂亮平台，踩上去100%漏底！跟着空气里微弱闪烁的蓝星点走吧！
hintSteps: 高处三块醒目的实体桥板全是全息假平台，跳上去必摔落深渊！
真正的通路藏在下层半空——留意星尘闪烁点，五块隐形踏板一踩即亮。
沿着低空隐形踏板稳步节奏连跳五次，即可直达右岸终点台！
trollQuoteEn: Every visible bridge is a lie; only the unseen shimmer holds your weight!
hintStepsEn: All three visible upper platforms are fake holograms—jumping to them is a trap!
Look lower for subtle cyan stardust glints marking five invisible stepping stones.
Hop steadily across the lower invisible bridge chain to reach the far cliff!

name: ▲高密度区
subtitle: 遍地黄金（物理意义上的臭黄金），像素级立定跳远考场
trollQuote: 别指望护盾救你，护盾闻到味儿早就跑路了！每一块干净落脚砖只有一格宽，多走半步就是社会性死亡！
hintSteps: 地面铺满高密度便便阵，护盾对此无效，切忌按住方向键贪快猛冲！
将目光锁定在每两堆便便之间的青色干净金属小垫台上，一跳一停稳扎稳打。
全程连跳四座青色安全垫台跨越雷区，干净利落拿下终点旗！
trollQuoteEn: 60% ground coverage of bio-hazards—precision platforming required!
hintStepsEn: The floor is packed with lethal poop clusters—don't hold run blindly!
Aim each jump cleanly onto the raised cyan metal stepping blocks between clusters.
Hop from cyan block to cyan block with controlled taps until you clear the field!

name: 炸弹连锁反应
subtitle: 爆破鬼才选修课：引爆右边开路，引爆左边直接把自己送走
trollQuote: 地上摆着两串火药桶炸弹！左边那串连着你脚底下的炸药，右边那串才连着封门巨墙——扔炸弹前看准朝向再松手！
hintSteps: 拾取地面的炸弹道具后，千万别朝左扔——左侧陷阱雷引爆会直接把你震飞出局！
先跳上中间的铜色安全高台，面朝右侧投出炸弹引爆地面第一颗连锁雷。
多米诺连锁爆破会一路炸塌右侧封门巨墙，待火光散去跳下高台夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Detonate right to clear the gate; detonate left to blow up your own floor!
hintStepsEn: Pick up the bomb, and never throw it left—the left barrel is a self-destruct trap!
Hop onto the raised copper platform and toss your bomb right toward the bomb chain.
Watch the domino blast demolish the fortress wall, then drop down to the flag!

name: 重力异常报告
subtitle: 天花板变地板、地板变深渊，牛顿的棺材板压不住了！
trollQuote: 踩进紫色光柱瞬间头朝下脚朝上！这时候天花板上的刺就是地刺，没封顶的天空反而成了摔死人的无底洞！
hintSteps: 踩上红色向上箭头启动反重力，哥查德会头下脚上吸附在紫色天花板上奔跑！
倒立时按跳跃键会『向下起跳』：看准时机跳过天花板上的两簇倒刺。
跑到天花板尽头踩中向下的重力恢复垫，稳稳落回地面右侧夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Up is down, ceiling spikes are floor spikes, and the open sky is a pit!
hintStepsEn: Step on the red upward arrow pad to invert gravity and walk upside-down on the ceiling!
Tap Jump while inverted to hop downward over the two ceiling spike patches.
Hit the downward gravity pad at the end of the ceiling to drop safely beside the flag!

name: 怪物组合拳
subtitle: 陆军牛皮糖 + 空军大眼蝠 + 生化武器▲ = 立体三线围剿
trollQuote: 天上飞着蝙蝠眼，地上追着紫恶魔，前头还摆着▲！硬刚必死，让导弹大哥帮你清理门户，再把紫恶魔骗进深沟！
hintSteps: 空中的紫翼飞眼怪畏惧能量子弹，先按攻击键远程清理掉半空拦截的飞眼怪！
地面防弹小恶魔依然靠智取：引诱它追到中段深坑边缘，起跳看它自己掉坑退场。
到右岸先射落第二只飞眼怪，再稳稳跳过地面两处便便夺旗！
trollQuoteEn: Bulletproof ground imp + aerial cyber-bats + poop mines!
hintStepsEn: Flying bat-eye monsters CAN be shot down—fire energy shots to clear the skies!
Lure the bulletproof ground imp into chasing you off the central pit edge.
Snipe the second flyer on the far bank, hop over both poop traps, and grab the flag!

name: 假墙迷宫
subtitle: 四堵一模一样的赛博高墙，真真假假全靠铁头功探路
trollQuote: 一楼撞不过去就跳二楼，二楼撞不过去就钻一楼！注意第3堵墙后面藏了朵阴险的骷髅红花，闭着眼猛冲可是会送命的！
hintSteps: 第一道紫墙『下真上假』：踩门前铜墩跃起，从上半截虚像墙穿过去！
第二道紫墙『上真下假』：别跳！直接贴着一楼地面穿墙而过，但穿墙瞬间立刻起跳躲开墙后冷枪红花！
第三道紫墙整面皆假，直接大步穿墙摸到终点真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Identical cyber walls, opposite physics—watch out for the ambush flower!
hintStepsEn: Wall 1 is solid below and fake above—use the copper step to jump through its upper half!
Wall 2 is fake at floor level—walk straight through, then jump immediately over the ambush flower!
Wall 3 is completely phantom—sprint right through it to the real flag!

name: 倒计时地狱
subtitle: 三只时钟三种命：加速死、子弹时间、绝对时停
trollQuote: 第1只钟碰了直接加速暴毙，第2只钟打爆开启慢动作让你优雅骑上超音速导弹，第3只钟打爆时停踩花过关！
hintSteps: 直接跳过第一只地面金闹钟（打爆会加速催命）！
跳上铜台击碎齿轮时钟开启『全场慢动作』，原本快如闪电的导弹瞬间变慢，从容跳上弹背过渊！
登岸后一枪击碎岸边时停金钟冻结整排骷髅花，踏冰直取真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Three clocks: 1st speeds death, 2nd triggers bullet-time, 3rd freezes reality!
hintStepsEn: Hop right over the first floor clock—shooting it speeds up the timer!
Jump onto the copper deck and shoot the gear clock for Slow-Motion, making the fast missile easy to board.
On the far bank, shoot the freeze clock to ice over the flower row and walk to the flag!

name: 公主很挑剔
subtitle: 强迫症晚期皇家公主：必须严格按【红 → 绿 → 蓝】顺序拾取彩礼！
trollQuote: 地上明明按『蓝、绿、红』摆在路中间诱惑你——你要是顺路捡了蓝宝石，公主当场翻脸把宝石全扬了让你重来！
hintSteps: 抬头看右侧挑剔公主头顶的气泡：她严格要求按【红 → 绿 → 蓝】顺序进贡宝石！
千万别听信路牌顺路乱捡！先一路跳过蓝宝石和绿宝石，跑到最右边先吃红宝石。
再往左折返依次拾取绿宝石、蓝宝石，最后回头找公主交差解封真旗！
trollQuoteEn: Royal OCD: Gems MUST be collected strictly in RED -> GREEN -> BLUE order!
hintStepsEn: Check the thought bubble above the Princess: she demands Red -> Green -> Blue in strict order!
Ignore the lying sign! Leap over the Blue and Green gems first to grab the Red Gem on the right.
Double back left for Green then Blue, and return to the Princess to unlock the goal!

name: 三层垂直要塞
subtitle: 一楼深坑炼金炉、二楼升降梯导弹桥、三楼真假管道天台——足足9
trollQuote: 一楼深坑炼金炉、二楼升降梯导弹桥、三楼真假管道天台——足足94格立体大要塞！
trollQuoteEn: 94-tile vertical citadel: Underground Alchemy Foundry, Cyber Elevator & Missile Viaduct, and Sky Pipe Bastion!
hintSteps: 地下层：下到盆地跳过鹅膏菌，顶问号吃毒蘑菇再撞红花炼成炸弹，轰开闸门乘升降梯上二楼。
二楼高架：激活信标存档后击碎齿轮钟冻结整排红花，搭水平穿梭板接力骑乘导弹横渡大裂谷。
三楼迷城：切勿钻左侧回城假管道！穿过紫色假墙进入真管道跃迁顶楼，越过假旗追上害羞真旗解锁第三章CG！
hintStepsEn: Lower Deck: Hop the amanita, hit the ? block for poison + touch the flower to bomb the gate, then ride the elevator up.
Mid Overpass: Hit the gear clock to freeze the flower bridge, then ride the shuttle and missile across the canyon.
Upper Maze: Skip the fake left pipe, walk through the purple phantom wall to the real pipe, and chase down the shy flag!

name: 三段跳的新烦恼
subtitle: 给你三段跳，偏修矮天花板；等你习惯低跳了，前面又来个无顶大峡
trollQuote: 给你三段跳，偏修矮天花板；等你习惯低跳了，前面又来个无顶大峡谷逼你三段满跳！
trollQuoteEn: Low spike roofs punish high jumps, then sudden open chasms demand full triple-jumps—watch the ceiling rhythm!
hintSteps: 压顶刺长廊：头顶倒刺密集，只用单次轻跳越过骷髅花（注意第二朵花会向前滑移偷袭！）与两块充能消失板。
开阔峡谷区：存档后头顶豁然开朗！连展三段跳翻上高阶梯，搭穿梭板过谷并把跟随怪引下断崖。
终局走廊：再次低跳穿过第二段压顶刺，最后三段跳飞越假旗孤岛，落岸追上躲闪一次的害羞真旗！
hintStepsEn: Low-Ceiling Hall: Use light single hops under the ceiling spikes to clear the sliding ambush flower and hover pads.
Open Canyon: Unleash Triple Jump up the tall steps, ride the shuttle, and bait the imp into the abyss.
Finale: Low-hop past the second spike ceiling, triple-jump over the fake-flag island, and catch the shy true flag!

name: 子弹打回来了
subtitle: 正面有钢盾挡着打不碎开关墙？向右侧高空镜面开一枪立刻跳起躲开
trollQuote: 正面有钢盾挡着打不碎开关墙？向右侧高空镜面开一枪立刻跳起躲开，让反弹回来的火焰弹从背后爆破！
trollQuoteEn: Barrier shielded from the front? Bank your fireball off a mirror behind it and leap over your own rebounding shot!
hintSteps: 一区隔镜挑射：切勿平地乱开火！踩青色踏板跃过矮镜，在半空轰碎上层封门墙后落向存档点。
二区台球破笼：毒蘑菇被免疫直射的晶化门锁住！翻过掩体站在右侧镜面前朝右开火并原地起跳——镜面折射回左的超速弹会击碎晶门！
三区连锁爆破：回头取毒菇撞红花炼雷，引爆多米诺雷群轰塌重墙，搭穿梭桥与升降梯隔镜破开终门夺旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Never fire at floor level! Hop from the cyan ledge over the short mirror to blast the upper door.
Zone 2 Bank-Shot: Vault past the prism cage, fire right into the mirror, and jump over the rebound so it shatters the prism door!
Zone 3: Grab the freed poison + touch the flower to trigger the domino bombs, then ride the lifts and snipe the final gate!

name: 护盾保险公司破产了
subtitle: 记住保险拒赔口诀：红花鹅膏刀云屎，护盾碰了照样死！把护盾留给
trollQuote: 记住保险拒赔口诀：红花鹅膏刀云屎，护盾碰了照样死！把护盾留给真尖刺与拦路蝙蝠眼！
trollQuoteEn: Insurance Rule: Flowers, mushrooms, knife-clouds & poop bypass Shields! Save your Shield strictly for spikes & bat-eyes!
hintSteps: 一区保盾护航：开局自带一层护盾！精细跳跃躲开红花、便便与鹅膏菌，把护盾留给宽幅地刺阵硬闯存档。
二区解毒金身：顶问号吃毒蘑菇后立刻搭穿梭板过渊，踩中对岸绿色解毒座化身金身，一路横扫密集花菌阵！
三区天际冲刺：顶隐藏砖补盾，踩蓝云撞开拦路飞眼怪，无视黑店与假旗，乘升降梯登顶夺真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Save your starting Shield! Jump cleanly over flowers, poop, and mushrooms so your shield blocks the wide spike pit.
Zone 2: Eat the ? poison, ride the shuttle across, and hit the green Antidote Pad to plow invincibly through the flower gauntlet!
Zone 3: Grab the hidden backup shield, hop the blue clouds past the flyer, skip the scam shop & fake flag, and take the lift up!

name: 会思考的陷阱
subtitle: 一楼装了深度学习陷阱矩阵，你在下面越死越密！聪明人抬头走高空
trollQuote: 一楼装了深度学习陷阱矩阵，你在下面越死越密！聪明人抬头走高空云岛与穿梭机天路，把地面AI晾成傻子！
trollQuoteEn: The ground AI multiplies traps every time you die downstairs—climb to the Sky Archipelago and leave the AI starving below!
hintSteps: 升空逃逸：地面每次阵亡都会追加陷阱，别走一楼！起点前顶出隐形砖，顺蓝云与穿梭板登上高空浮岛存档。
坠牌搭桥：跳过浮岛鹅膏菌，引诱高空悬挂路牌坠落当跳板，连跨两块充能消失板乘升降梯登二号空岛。
时停终航：击碎空岛齿轮钟冻结全场陷阱，从岛缘跳上导弹飞越长峡，越过假旗穿紫色假墙夺真旗！
hintStepsEn: Take to the Skies: Skip the adaptive ground traps! Reveal the hidden step near spawn and climb the clouds & shuttle to Sky Island 1.
Signpost Bridge: Bait the hanging sign down as a step, dash across both hover-pads, and ride the lift to Sky Island 2.
Frozen Flight: Shoot the gear clock to freeze hazards, surf the missile across the chasm, and pass the phantom wall to win!

name: 时间悖论
subtitle: 三座锁死在二楼的激光神殿，钥匙全在一楼宽敞无阻的时空涵洞里—
trollQuote: 三座锁死在二楼的激光神殿，钥匙全在一楼宽敞无阻的时空涵洞里——先在二楼留影2秒，再跳进涵洞捏碎沙漏回溯穿门！
trollQuoteEn: Three locked upper Laser Vaults, three ground-floor Hourglass Tunnels—stand upstairs for 2s, drop in, and rewind past the gates!
hintSteps: 第一神殿：先跳上二楼铜台驻足片刻留下过去幻影，再跳入下方涵洞触碰时间沙漏——瞬间回溯上楼并解开一道激光门！
裂谷广场：存档后把地面跟随怪勾引坠入深谷，搭穿梭板抵达广场并轻松跳过露天的诱饵假旗。
双连悖论：乘升降梯依次在两座二楼高台驻足留影、跳下涵洞触碰沙漏回溯穿门，连破三道激光门夺取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Temple 1: Stand briefly on the upper copper ledge to record your past position, then drop into the tunnel and touch the Hourglass to rewind past Gate 1!
Chasm Plaza: Lure the imp into the gap, ride the shuttle across, and hop cleanly over the decoy flag.
Twin Paradoxes: Repeat the upper-ledge pause + tunnel Hourglass rewind twice more to unlock Gates 2 & 3 and claim the flag!

name: 镜像世界访客
subtitle: 92格全程左右镜像西行远征！翻越反向阶梯山、搭反向穿梭机、在
trollQuote: 92格全程左右镜像西行远征！翻越反向阶梯山、搭反向穿梭机、在镜像操作下炼炸弹轰门并骑导弹向西冲锋！
trollQuoteEn: 92-tile westbound odyssey with MIRRORED controls: reverse mountain stairs, shuttles, bomb alchemy, and westbound missiles!
hintSteps: 镜像反转开启：按右往左走、按左往右走！千万别去碰出生点右侧的死路假旗，一路向西翻越铜阶梯并躲开滑移伏击花。
西行炼金：存档后顶问号吃毒蘑菇、撞红花炼成炸弹轰穿西侧铜墙，再搭穿梭板与消失台继续西进。
乘西风导弹：在发射岛边缘跳上向西疾驰的导弹横渡宽谷，落地穿过紫色假墙追上害羞真旗！
hintStepsEn: Mirror Controls Active: Left and Right are swapped! Ignore the east decoy flag and head west over the copper stairs.
Westbound Alchemy: Eat the ? poison + touch the flower to bomb open the west wall, then cross the shuttle and hover-pad.
Westbound Missile: Surf the west-firing missile across the canyon, pass the purple phantom wall, and catch the shy flag!

name: 一切都是假的…
subtitle: 铺满金币的豪华天桥一踩就穿，写着出口的绿管把你送回起点，连商
trollQuote: 铺满金币的豪华天桥一踩就穿，写着出口的绿管把你送回起点，连商店老板和三面旗子全在演戏！
trollQuoteEn: The coin-paved skybridge is a hologram, the 'EXIT' pipe loops you back, and three decoy flags guard a hidden fake-wall keep!
hintSteps: 真假分岔桥：跳过带刀路牌，绝不踩铺满金币的全息假铜桥！从桥头起跳踩三块高空隐形踏板安全过渊。
真假双墙：第一堵紫墙直接穿过；第二堵钢墙是实心墙，引诱头顶路牌坠落垫脚翻越，再炼毒花炸弹引爆多米诺雷群破城！
真假管道与双假旗：无视黑店与回城假管，搭穿梭板钻入对岸真管道登顶，连越两面假旗穿假墙夺真旗！
hintStepsEn: Mirage Bridge: Jump the blade sign and ignore the fake coin bridge—cross via the three high invisible blocks instead!
Twin Walls: Walk through the purple phantom wall, drop the hanging sign to vault the steel wall, and chain-bomb the fortress!
True Pipe: Skip the shop and first warp-trap pipe, ride the shuttle to the far pipe, hop both fake flags, and pass the final fake wall!

name: Boss预告·追击战
subtitle: 98格五战区超长生死追击！机甲骷髅王全程贴脸狂飙——沿途5座
trollQuote: 98格五战区超长生死追击！机甲骷髅王全程贴脸狂飙——沿途5座金闹钟就是你的5发冰封氮气加速包！
trollQuoteEn: 98-tile 5-sector Boss chase! Shoot all 5 Gold Stun Clocks along the highway to freeze the charging Mecha-Skull!
hintSteps: 机甲巨骷髅全程在背后追击，绝不恋战回头！一二战区连发子弹击碎两只金钟定住Boss，跨过消失桥踩弹簧跃上高架。

trollQuoteEn: Stop staring at the Shy Eye Blocks! Jump forward, tap backward mid-air to turn your back, and they'll solidify right under your boots!
clearText: MOONWALK MASTER：你用优雅的背身礼仪征服了害羞砖。
clearTextEn: MOONWALK MASTER: Your polite turn-around conquered every Shy Block.
hintSteps: 一区（背身过桥）：带大眼睛的【害羞砖】被注视时会虚化，向右跳到半空立刻轻点【左方向键】转身背对它，地板就会瞬间凝实托住你！
二区（逃跑地砖+相位锁）：存档后先假跳一步骗长脚地板滑移站定，再射击上方【LOCK】青色节点锁死闪烁相位台。
三区（隔镜背身一石二鸟）：站在害羞砖上必须面朝左才能站稳——刚好朝左开火借左侧反射镜折射子弹，绕后击破右侧晶盾守卫与棱镜门！
四区（盯住反套路收官）：末段高台藏着真旗，底层露天的旗子是回城假旗；先射击校准紫红叛变弹簧，直飞顶层露台摘真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Eye-marked Shy Blocks vanish while watched! Jump right, then tap Left mid-air to face away so each block solidifies beneath you.
Zone 2: Feint-hop to let the legged Runaway Floor scoot into place, then shoot the [LOCK] node to solidify the blinking phase bridge.
Zone 3: Facing left keeps your Shy Block solid AND lets you bounce shots off the left Mirror to shatter the right prism gate & shield bot!
Zone 4: Ignore the lower warp-trap flag! Shoot the crimson Betrayal Spring once to calibrate it green, then bounce up to the upper terrace flag!

objs.text: 别盯着大眼砖看！起跳转身背对它！
objs.textEn: DON'T STARE! TURN AWAY IN MID-AIR!

name: 磁铁与贪财鬼
subtitle: 金币摆在压顶锤正下方，叛变弹簧反推才是登顶捷径
trollQuote: 看到磁力块上摆着两枚亮晶晶金币就冲上去捡？头顶压顶砖笑得牙都露出来啦！还有最后那个弹簧，故意让它反踢一脚试试喵？
trollQuoteEn: Rushed for the shiny coins under an ambush crusher?! And at the end, don't curse the backward spring—use its reverse kick to land on the magnetic lift!
clearText: POLARITY TRICKSTER：磁极与反向弹射全被你玩明白了。
clearTextEn: POLARITY TRICKSTER: You turned magnetic traps and reverse springs into shortcuts.
hintSteps: 一区（金币诱饵与磁桥）：别贪磁块上方的诱饵金币（头顶有偷袭压顶砖），先射击磁极节点切为【蓝极】将磁块吸来搭桥稳步通过。
二区（磁盾挡炮+宝箱怪）：射击二号磁极节点让金属块横移挡住狙击炮塔红线；路边的金宝箱是宝箱怪，挥魔剑两刀斩除即可开门！
三区（双极阶梯接力）：先用蓝极把低处磁块吸到脚下跳上去，再在半空挥剑切换为【橙极】让高处磁块滑出接住你。
四区（反向弹簧妙用）：终点高台太高跳不上去？踩右侧【反向弹簧】故意让它把你往左上方斜踢，精准落在高空磁力平台上夺取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Don't grab the bait coins under the Ceiling Crusher first—shoot the Polarity Node to pull the Blue block into a safe bridge!
Zone 2: Toggle the second magnet to block the sniper Turret's laser line, then slay the Mimic Chest with two Sword Slashes [U] to open the gate!
Zone 3: Step onto the low Blue block, then shoot the node mid-hop to shift the upper Orange block into a staircase.
Zone 4: Stand on the right-side Reverse Spring (`back_yeet`) so it flings you backward-up onto the high magnetic balcony and the real flag!

objs.text: 高台太远？借右边叛变弹簧反踢上楼！
objs.textEn: TOO HIGH? USE REVERSE SPRING KICK!

objs.text: 磁力养生区 · 免费吸铁

name: 顺风局最致命
subtitle: 狂风吹人撞顶刺，生吞500公斤毒奶爱心竟是唯一生路
trollQuote: 平时骂本喵放毒奶爱心坑你，这关飓风把你往天花板红刺上吹的时候，知道『500KG千斤坠』有多香了吧？万物皆可反套路喵！
trollQuoteEn: Usually you hate my 500KG Lead-Boots Trojan Heart—until an updraft hurricane tries to pin you into ceiling spikes! Eat the 'curse' to walk safely underneath!
clearText: HEAVYWEIGHT GENIUS：你把毒奶千斤坠变成了防风神装。
clearTextEn: HEAVYWEIGHT GENIUS: You turned a 500KG curse into windproof armor.
hintSteps: 一区（逆看路牌看粒子）：路牌吹嘘顺风全是骗人的，看风场彩色粒子飘向——首段强顺风只需轻点小跳，满跳会撞进右侧藏刀乌云！
二区（生吞500KG毒奶抗飓风）：二区暴烈上升风会把普通体重直接吹上天花板尖刺！故意吃掉路边的【500KG♥毒奶爱心】挂上千斤坠，稳稳贴地走过风洞！
三区（背身风洞跳台）：逆风区配合两块【害羞砖】，起跳后顺势背身微调，射击【FAN-OFF】青色节点关停狂风陷阱。
四区（追击害羞真旗）：斩破守门机械猎犬后，终点真旗会害羞连跳逃跑两次，提前预判前方逃跑地砖完成冲刺摘旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Ignore the lying wind sign and read the particle drift—tap a tiny hop in the strong tailwind so you don't overshoot into the Knife Cloud!
Zone 2: The upward hurricane slams normal weight into ceiling spikes! Deliberately eat the [500KG♥] Trojan Heart so its lead-boots curse keeps you grounded!
Zone 3: Cross the Shy Blocks against the headwind and shoot the [FAN-OFF] node to shut down the storm.
Zone 4: Slay the cyber-hound, bait the Runaway Floor, and chase down the shy hopping Goal Flag!

objs.text: 前方十级逆风 · 请助跑满跳！
暴风掀顶！不吃500KG毒奶必撞刺！
objs.textEn: UPDRAFT! EAT 500KG HEART OR HIT SPIKES!

name: 弹窗广告拦截器
subtitle: 有的弹窗要关右上角X，有的流氓弹窗得踩在脑门上当桥走
trollQuote: 看见报错弹窗就条件反射去点右上角 [X]？第二个流氓弹窗写着 BRIDGE.SYS，你把它关了拿头飞过去呀？踩它红脑门还能拿记忆碎片喵！
trollQuoteEn: Closing every popup on sight?! The second popup says BRIDGE.SYS—walk across its red title bar instead of closing it, and snag a bonus Memory Shard!
clearText: ADBLOCK LEGEND：流氓弹窗也拦不住你的走位。
clearTextEn: ADBLOCK LEGEND: Even rogue system popups became your stepping stones.
hintSteps: 一区（真假弹窗辨析）：第一扇『ERR_404』弹窗拦在大路上，跳起攻击顶部红栏【X】将其关闭；深渊中央的『BRIDGE.SYS』铁头弹窗则是实心踏脚台，直接踩着它的红标题栏跳过去（顺路可登高拾取★裂界记忆碎片）！
二区（真假光纤中继）：认准连有发光青色光纤的真节点锁定丢包相位桥，无光纤的红紫假节点只会放嘲讽烟花。
三区（净化存档+压顶跳台）：挥剑净化恶魔假存档后，引诱压顶砖落地垫脚翻越高墙。
四区（宝箱怪守卫总闸）：终点门前潜伏着贪婪宝箱怪，切勿贴脸贪财，用魔剑两记三倍斩击将其击破即可开启主门摘旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Jump and hit the top red [X] bar to close the first [ERR_404] popup, then jump ON TOP OF the unclosable [BRIDGE.SYS] popup over the abyss (climb upper decks for a ★Memory Shard)!
Zone 2: Trace the glowing fiber cable to shoot the real cyan Signal Node and lock the blinking phase platforms.
Zone 3: Slash the horned Traitor Checkpoint to purify it, then bait the Ceiling Crusher down to climb over the divider wall.
Zone 4: Wake the Mimic Chest from safe sword range and slay it with two Melee Slashes [U] to open the exit gate!

objs.text: 弹窗已清空 · 安心摸真旗！
恭喜您中奖一百万金币！

name: 左脑攻击，右脑劈叉
subtitle: 小丑诅咒图腾让你左右互搏，远射破除光环再骗逃跑地板
trollQuote: 刚迈进紫色光环怎么自己往坑里退着走啦？小丑图腾正在给你的左右脑调换网线呢！隔远点一发剑波打哑它不就完事了喵！
trollQuoteEn: Why did you moonwalk into the pit?! The Jester Totem swaps Left & Right inside its purple ring—snipe it from outside or embrace reverse-brain mode!
clearText: BRAIN REWIRED：左右互搏再也骗不到你的手指。
clearTextEn: BRAIN REWIRED: Jester confusion rings can no longer trick your thumbs.
hintSteps: 一区（初识反转图腾）：紫色颗粒圆环是【小丑反转图腾】领域，圈内左右方向键对调！站在圈外开火或挥剑击中图腾即可令其瘫痪 5.5 秒从容过桥。
二区（先破图腾再骗地板）：先远射打哑二号图腾，再上前假跳骗【逃跑地砖】滑到位跨越断崖。
三区（双炮塔掩体反杀）：蹲在金属掩体后避开狙击炮塔红线齐射，打哑高台不可永久摧毁的图腾或顺着【⇄ REVERSE】反向走位切入炮塔盲区拆掉【JAM-1/2】。
四区（假墙暗道绕后）：正面有重盾机兵与假旗双重陷阱，钻入下方全息假墙地道从背后挥剑破敌，登上顶台摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Stepping inside the Jester Totem's purple pixel ring reverses Left/Right controls! Shoot the totem from outside to disable it for 5.5s.
Zone 2: Snipe Totem #2 first so your controls stay normal while feint-baiting the Runaway Floor across the chasm.
Zone 3: Use low cover to dodge Sniper Turret volleys and hit both [JAM-1] and [JAM-2] nodes to open the jammer gate.
Zone 4: Don't charge the frontal Shield Mech & decoy flag—slip through the lower fake wall to flank from behind and climb to the real goal!

objs.textEn: LEFT IS RIGHT, RIGHT IS PIT

name: 我杀我自己·进阶版
subtitle: 金币走廊是残影瓮中捉鳖局，压顶砖垫脚反跃自己头顶
trollQuote: 看见一排金币就闷头钻进死胡同，转身正好一头撞进 1.7 秒前自己的怀里！借压顶砖跳回二楼把过去的自己甩在楼下吃灰吧喵！
trollQuoteEn: Followed the shiny coin trail into a dead-end and French-kissed your own lethal 1.7s shadow?! Bait the crusher, vault upstairs, and juke your past self via Portals!
clearText: SHADOW JUKED：过去的你连你的衣角都没摸着。
clearTextEn: SHADOW JUKED: Your 1.7-second-old assassin ate your dust.
hintSteps: 一区（致命残影禁停）：1.7 秒前的红色残影会全程追杀你，切勿原地折返！无视底层死胡同金币诱饵，引落压顶砖后立刻登二楼高架甩开残影。
二区（边跑边挥剑净化）：奔跑途中顺手挥剑【U】净化恶魔假存档碑，跨过害羞砖断桥（半空轻点左键背身落地即走，别停留！）。
三区（单向传送门甩影）：钻入底层【A→】单向传送门瞬移至高台出口，让紧追不舍的残影扑空。
四区（校准弹簧飞越假旗）：提前远程开火打绿【叛变弹簧】，不停步直接弹上顶层摘下真旗（底层食人旗千万别碰）！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Your 1.7s lethal shadow kills on contact—never backtrack on flat ground! Skip the lower coin dead-end, bait the Ceiling Crusher, and vault onto the upper catwalk.
Zone 2: Slash [U] the horned Traitor Save on the run to purify it, then moonwalk-hop across the Shy Block without lingering.
Zone 3: Dive into one-way Portal [A->] to warp onto the upper deck and break your shadow's pursuit line.
Zone 4: Pre-fire a shot as you approach to calibrate the Betrayal Spring green, launching cleanly over the lower Mimic Flag to the rooftop goal!

name: 带电作业禁止投弹
subtitle: 背上电池不能扔炸弹？那就先喂饱宝箱怪再回来取货
trollQuote: 背着高压电池就按不出炸弹键，偏偏前面趴着一只只吃炸弹的贪嘴宝箱怪！不知道先把路炸通了再回头背电池吗？送电工也要讲工序喵！
trollQuoteEn: Carrying a Signal Battery disables bombs—right in front of a bomb-hungry Mimic Chest! Feed the chest FIRST, then carry the battery through!
clearText: MASTER ELECTRICIAN：先清场后送电，施工流程满分。
clearTextEn: MASTER ELECTRICIAN: Clear hazards first, haul batteries second—textbook logistics.
hintSteps: 一区（先喂宝箱怪再背电池）：携带信号电池时禁用炸弹！因此先别捡起点的 1 号电池，先拿高台炸弹喂饱拦路的【贪食宝箱怪】开闸，再折返背起 1 号电池插进一区插槽！
二区（压顶梯与假弹窗）：乘通电启动的穿梭台过谷，关闭『VOLT_ERR』弹窗右上角【X】，引落压顶砖垫脚登上二楼。
三区（背着2号电池走太空步）：拾取高台 2 号电池后，利用半空转身背对【害羞砖】稳稳渡过断崖（避开悬空的反转毒奶心）。
四区（双槽断电夺真旗）：将 2 号电池嵌入终段插槽彻底关闭笼罩终点的致命高压电弧，轻松挥剑驯服或越过护栏摘旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Carrying a Battery blocks bomb-throwing! Skip Battery #1 first, grab the upper Bomb to stuff the bomb-eating Mimic Chest, then go back for Battery #1 and slot it!
Zone 2: Ride the powered rail shuttle, close the [VOLT_ERR] popup's top [X] bar, and bait the Ceiling Crusher down to climb up.
Zone 3: Pick up Battery #2 and moonwalk-land across the Shy Blocks while dodging the floating Confusion Heart.
Zone 4: Insert Battery #2 into the final Relay Slot to shut off the Electric Arc guarding the true Goal Flag!

objs.text: 高压危险 · 请用舌头试电

name: 程序员的耳光第一课
subtitle: 路牌密码全写反，程序员伸手扇你时记得挥剑反扇回去
trollQuote: 本程序员亲手伸出赛博大巴掌跟你打招呼，你居然拿脸硬接？！看清蓄力金光按【挥剑键 U】反扇回去呀——致敬经典，懂不懂礼尚往来喵！
trollQuoteEn: Taking the Developer's Giant Gauntlet right on the cheek?! Wait for the golden windup glow and press Sword Slash [U] to SLAP IT RIGHT BACK!
clearText: DEV SLAPPER：那一记响亮的反手剑耳光扇得极其清脆。
clearTextEn: DEV SLAPPER: That backhand sword-slap echoed all the way to GitHub.
hintSteps: 一区（倒念路牌密码）：木牌故意把密码倒写成『花→钟→云』坑你，真顺序是反过来的【1号云 → 2号钟 → 3号花】！依次射击三枚对应节点开门。
二区（反扇程序员耳光）：巨型赛博铁掌蓄力亮起金光提示『SLASH [U]!』时，果断上前按【U/挥剑键】反扇它一巴掌，直接轰开封锁闸门！
三区（先锁轨道台再拆核）：穿过小丑反转图腾区（可先打哑图腾），先射击【HOLD】节点把乱晃的轨道平台钉在半空当踏板，再跳过断谷。
四区（二连耳光与弹窗藏旗）：再反扇第二只程序员巨掌破除终门，忽略门前食人假旗，劈开末端『WIN_404』弹窗即可见到隐藏真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: The wooden sign writes the password backwards! Shoot the sequence nodes in reverse order: [1: CLOUD -> 2: GEAR -> 3: FLOWER]!
Zone 2: When the giant Developer Gauntlet glows gold (`SLASH [U]!`), strike it with your Magic Sword [U] to slap it right back and shatter Gate 2!
Zone 3: Disable the Jester Totem, then shoot the [HOLD] node when the moving rail platform reaches mid-gap to lock a steady bridge.
Zone 4: Backhand the second Developer Gauntlet, skip the decoy Mimic Flag, and slice open the [WIN_404] popup hiding the real flag!

objs.text: 巨掌发光时按[U/挥剑]反扇耳光！
objs.textEn: PRESS SWORD [U] ON GLOW TO SLAP BACK!

name: 信号风暴核心
subtitle: 第六章统御Boss：骗过长脚桥与假存档，斩断风暴真电缆
trollQuote: 连闯逃跑桥、害羞台和程序员巴掌居然还没趴下？看看本喵压箱底的信号风暴核心吧——打错假电缆可是会放烟花嘲笑你的哦！
trollQuoteEn: Survived runaway bridges, shy tiles, and dev slaps?! Meet the Signal Storm Core—cut the three shield relays and trace the REAL power cable!
clearText: CH.6 CLEARED：信号风暴平息，城市重燃霓虹。
clearTextEn: CH.6 CLEARED: The Signal Storm subsides and neon lights return.
hintSteps: 前哨一区：先假跳骗【逃跑地砖】归位，背身踏过【害羞砖】，再挥剑净化恶魔假存档碑。
前哨二区：看准蓄力金光反扇程序员巨掌轰开Boss大门，拾取问号砖护盾与烈焰剑波步入风暴核心室（独立Boss存档点）。
Boss一、二阶段：先击亮左、中、右三枚【N-1/2/3】护盾节点破除一阶段装甲并挥剑输出；二阶段借中央上升气流跃起挥剑猛劈暴露核心！
Boss三阶段决胜：忽略无连线的 FAKE 诱饵节点，击中顶部连着发光主缆的【CABLE】真节点彻底破盾，挥剑终结信号风暴解锁第六章剧情CG！
hintStepsEn: Outpost 1: Bait the Runaway Floor, moonwalk across the Shy Block, and purify the horned Traitor Save with your sword.
Outpost 2: Slap back the Developer Gauntlet with [U] to breach the Boss Gate and grab the Shield & Flame upgrade before the arena checkpoint.
Boss Phases 1–2: Activate all 3 [N-1/2/3] shield nodes to damage Phase 1, then ride the central updraft in Phase 2 to slash the core!
Boss Phase 3: Ignore unlinked FAKE decoys, shoot the real fiber-linked [CABLE] node above, and finish the Signal Storm Core for Chapter 6's CG!

objs.text: 风暴机房重地 · 闲猫免进

name: 黑心流水线入职培训
subtitle: VIP加速履带直通碎纸机，偷袭锤与校准弹簧才是老员工通道
trollQuote: 入职第一天就抢着走二楼鲜红的『VIP高管快车道』？那条传送带是专门把摸鱼新员工送进尖刺碎纸机的喵！老实走下面车间通道吧！
trollQuoteEn: Took the shiny red 'VIP FAST LANE' conveyor on your first day?! That belt dumps rookies straight into the shredder—take the lower foundry floor!
clearText: PROBATION PASSED：你活着熬过了黑心工厂的试用期。
clearTextEn: PROBATION PASSED: You survived orientation without getting shredded.
hintSteps: 一区（避开VIP红履带）：二楼红色快速传送带会把人直接甩进尖刺坑！走底层青色工位带，引落压顶砖垫脚翻过隔墙。
二区（三拍液压锤凹槽）：观察液压冲锤『黄灯→预压→重砸』三拍节奏，在地面低凹安全槽暂避，切勿贪走。
三区（先校准弹簧再关逆带）：先开火把紫红【叛变弹簧】打绿弹上二楼，击中【STOP】节点停住下方的逆向红履带！
四区（假旗诱饵与高架真旗）：终点底层红履带尽头是咬人的食人拟态旗，乘上方穿梭板走车间天桥即可摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Skip the upper red VIP Fast Belt (it flings you into spikes)! Take the lower blue belt and bait the Ceiling Crusher down to climb over.
Zone 2: Read the 3-beat Hydraulic Pistons (Yellow Warn -> Pre-press -> Slam) and shelter inside the floor recesses.
Zone 3: Shoot the Betrayal Spring once to calibrate it green, bounce up to hit [STOP], and halt the reverse conveyor below!
Zone 4: Ignore the lower Mimic Flag at the end of the trap belt—ride the overhead rail shuttle across the catwalk to the real flag!

objs.textEn: ^ TAKE UPPER RED VIP FAST LANE!

name: 和平白鸽禁止亮剑
subtitle: 戴墨镜的和平鸽肚下绑着核弹，谁敢拔剑开枪就炸谁
trollQuote: 本喵专门从《正常的大冒险》请来的墨镜和平鸽大使，嘴叼橄榄枝、肚绑高爆弹！在停火走廊手贱挥剑开火？享受地毯式核平轰炸吧喵！
trollQuoteEn: Meet our sunglasses-wearing Peace Dove Envoy—olive branch in beak, nuke strapped to belly! Swing your sword or shoot in its ceasefire zone and get carpet-bombed!
clearText: NOBEL PACIFIST：你在核平白鸽注视下展现了高尚的武德。
clearTextEn: NOBEL PACIFIST: You kept your blade sheathed under the Nuclear Peace Dove's gaze.
hintSteps: 一区（双锯交错安全岛）：不要追着轨道电锯跑，站在中央亮灯平台等两把锯刃背向退开时从容跃过。
二区（停战长廊严禁开火挥剑）：头顶飞舞着【NO FIRE ♥ 核平白鸽】！在其巡逻视野内千万别按射击或挥剑键（否则白鸽暴怒投弹并锁死和平门；若误触请停手躲避 3.4 秒即可消气开门），纯靠跳跃跨过小怪并蹭白鸽拿免费护盾！
三区（出保护区再亮剑）：穿过开启的和平闸门远离白鸽后，放手挥剑反扇程序员巨掌、击碎电锯总控节点【SAW-OFF】！
四区（驯服食人旗收官）：跳过逃跑地砖，在终点前挥魔剑揍服食人拟态旗即可过关！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Stand on the central safety island and wait for the twin Orbit Saws to diverge before crossing.

Zone 2 (CEASEFIRE ZONE): Do NOT shoot or swing your sword near the [NO FIRE ♥] Peace Dove! Jump over ground hazards peacefully (touching the calm dove even grants a free Shield!) to stroll through the open Peace Gate.
Zone 3: Once well past the Peace Gate, draw your sword again to slap back the Developer Gauntlet and hit [SAW-OFF]!
Zone 4: Bait the Runaway Floor and tame the final Mimic Flag with one Sword Slash [U]!

objs.text: 停火区！当着白鸽开火挥剑必遭核平！
objs.textEn: CEASEFIRE! DO NOT ATTACK NEAR PEACE DOVE!

objs.text: 白鸽脾气好 · 真的不炸人

name: 暴躁叉车与贪嘴箱
subtitle: 踩叉车车顶当蹦床，给守门大宝箱塞颗高爆炸弹当下午茶
trollQuote: 跟钢铁叉车面对面顶牛？踩它车顶能当移动蹦床飞上货架懂不懂！至于仓库大门那只刀枪不入的宝箱怪，请它吃颗热乎炸弹呗喵！
trollQuoteEn: Stop headbutting armored forklifts—bounce off their roofs like trampolines! And for the blade-proof Mimic Chest blocking Dock 4, feed it a live Bomb!
clearText: WAREHOUSE BOSS：叉车成了你的坐骑，宝箱怪成了礼花。
clearTextEn: WAREHOUSE BOSS: Forklifts became trampolines and the Mimic Chest went boom.
hintSteps: 一区（踩叉车顶飞跃）：暴躁叉车正面碰撞致命，但从上方踩中车顶会自动高弹！借一号叉车顶跃上高架货台。
二区（磁力货箱搭阶梯+记忆碎片）：射击磁极节点将三只金属货箱吸成 1-2-3 阶梯；登顶左跃穿过虚空幽魂可顺手摘取★裂界记忆碎片！
三区（404货单弹窗）：踩二号叉车顶跃起击破『CARGO_404』弹窗右上角【X】，打通军火补给间。
四区（炸弹投喂宝箱怪）：堵在出口闸门前的巨型宝箱怪免疫刀剑与子弹，拾取货架上的【炸弹】按投弹键塞进它嘴里，一发撑爆即可开门摘旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Forklifts hurt from the side, but stomping their roofs launches you sky-high! Bounce off Forklift #1 onto the upper shelf.
Zone 2: Shoot the Polarity Node to align three magnetic crates into a 1-2-3 staircase (hop left at the top past the Wisp for a ★Memory Shard!).
Zone 3: Bounce off Forklift #2 to strike the top [X] bar of the [CARGO_404] popup.
Zone 4: Grab the shelf Bomb and throw it into the blade-proof Mimic Chest (`FEED BOMB!`) to blow open the exit gate!

objs.text: 叉车正面撞死人 · 踩车顶可高弹！
objs.textEn: STOMP FORKLIFT ROOFS TO BOUNCE HIGH!

name: 镜面流弹自杀指南
subtitle: 起跳自动开枪的诅咒图腾，配上一面反射镜就是爆自己狗头
trollQuote: 进了走火图腾圈还敢对着反射镜欢快起跳？砰——一跳一枪精准反弹爆自己脑门！背过身再跳，或者借这发走火弹去阴后面的重盾怪呀喵！
trollQuoteEn: Inside a Jump-Fire Totem ring, every jump shoots a bullet—jump while facing a Mirror and you'll snipe YOUR OWN FACE! Turn away before jumping, or bank-shot enemies!
clearText: TRICKSHOT SURVIVOR：你忍住了对着镜子开枪自杀的冲动。
clearTextEn: TRICKSHOT SURVIVOR: You mastered jump-triggered mirror bank-shots without shooting yourself.
hintSteps: 一区（走火图腾防自杀）：本关小丑图腾附带【起跳自动开枪】诅咒！正对反射镜起跳会被反弹流弹秒杀——务必【背对镜子起跳】（或先打哑图腾）翻越镜墙！
二区（借走火折射破棱镜门）：站在高台朝左对准远端反射镜起跳，折射高速弹飞越头顶击破右侧【折射专属棱镜墙】与重盾机兵后背！
三区（背身害羞砖+走火校准弹簧）：背身跳上害羞砖的同时，走火射出的剑波刚好顺手打绿后方的叛变弹簧！
四区（反扇巨掌与真假双旗）：反扇程序员巨掌破除终门，跳过前排假旗，用折射弹轰开最后一道棱镜屏障摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: These Jester Totems trigger an automatic shot every time you Jump! Never jump while facing a Mirror—turn your back before jumping (or shoot the totem first)!
Zone 2: Stand between the left Mirror and right Prism Gate, face left, and jump/shoot so the ricochet shatters the Prism Gate & flanks the Shield Mech!
Zone 3: Moonwalk across the Shy Blocks and calibrate the Betrayal Spring to vault onto the upper catwalk.
Zone 4: Slap back the Developer Gauntlet with [U], hop over the decoy flag, and bank one final mirror shot to unlock the real goal!

objs.text: 图腾圈内起跳会自动开火 · 别面向镜子跳！
objs.textEn: JUMPING FIRES SHOTS HERE · DON'T FACE MIRRORS!

name: 免费爱心大派送
subtitle: 奸商黑店、毒奶红心与假旗火葬场，真生路藏在地板裂缝下
trollQuote: 路边黑店写着特惠促销、半空飘着免费红心、尽头插着鲜艳大旗——把这三样全踩一遍的冤大头，本喵直接给你颁发年度慈善家奖状喵！
trollQuoteEn: Discount shady shop, floating FREE♥ hearts, and a red speed-belt to a shiny flag—fall for all three and I'll crown you Gullible Knight of the Year!
clearText: SCAM IMMUNE：天下没有免费的午餐，但有打碎外壳的真护盾。
clearTextEn: SCAM IMMUNE: You shattered the scam shell and found the secret underpass.
hintSteps: 一区（无视黑店与毒奶群）：别花金币按『下』买奸商黑店，也别直接吃履带上方飘浮的反转毒奶心，稳步跳过履带组。
二区（开枪打碎红粉毒奶提纯护盾）：高台那颗红标【FREE♥】毒奶心生吞必死，但【开火或挥剑击碎它】就能提纯为真能量护盾并开启闸门！
三区（压顶砖与404桥）：净化恶魔假存档，踩『BRIDGE.SYS』铁头弹窗跨过尖刺池，斩除拦路处刑机甲。
四区（急刹下潜暗道）：终点红色加速带直通咬人食人旗！在轨道穿梭板前看准地面紫色微光【全息假地板】，直接踩穿落入下层维护密道摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Don't buy from the scam Shop or touch the floating Confusion Hearts above the conveyor belt!
Zone 2: Do NOT touch the crimson [FREE♥] Trojan Heart—shoot or slash it instead to shatter its trap shell into a real Shield & gate unlock!
Zone 3: Purify the horned Traitor Save, walk across the top of [BRIDGE.SYS], and defeat the Executioner Mech.
Zone 4: The final red speed-belt feeds you to a Mimic Flag! Step through the glowing purple Fake Floor just before the belt to drop into the real underpass exit!

objs.text: 别用脸吃红心 · 开火打碎外壳拿真盾！
objs.textEn: DON'T TOUCH RED HEART · SHOOT IT FOR SHIELD!

objs.text: 假一赔命 · 童叟无欺

name: 慢动作处刑合唱团
subtitle: 时间泡里子弹慢如蜗牛，边挥剑弹反边走太空步
trollQuote: 四座重炮塔给你开专场音乐会呢！踏进黄金时间泡里，子弹飞得比老奶奶散步还慢——顺手拿魔剑劈掉几颗子弹耍个帅再走呗喵！
trollQuoteEn: Four Sniper Turrets harmonizing at your forehead! Step inside the golden Time Bubbles where lasers crawl like snails, parry shots with [U], and moonwalk through!
clearText: MATRIX MAESTRO：你在慢动作弹雨里跳出了一支华尔兹。
clearTextEn: MATRIX MAESTRO: You waltzed and parried right through bullet-time crossfire.
hintSteps: 一区（时间泡内背身过桥）：黄金【时间泡】只减速机关与敌弹，绝不减速哥查德！在时间泡内从容背身踏过【害羞砖】躲开慢速激光（挥剑还可直接斩切敌弹）。
二区（时间泡慢速逃跑砖）：被时间泡笼罩的【逃跑地砖】连逃跑都变成慢动作，轻松踩着它跳上二楼打掉【MUTE-1】炮塔总控！
三区（双锯+核平白鸽混搭）：先收剑静默走过白鸽停火桥，出了白鸽视野后再挥剑反扇程序员巨掌开门！
四区（时间泡终极齐射破阵）：借大号时间泡钻过三连炮塔齐射网，击亮【MUTE-2】彻底关停防线夺取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Golden Time Bubbles slow bullets & traps to a crawl while you move at full speed! Moonwalk across the Shy Blocks inside the bubble and parry stray shots with [U].
Zone 2: Inside Time Bubble #2, even the Runaway Floor scoots in slow motion—step right off it onto the upper deck and hit [MUTE-1]!
Zone 3: Keep weapons holstered under the Peace Dove, then draw your sword past the Peace Gate to backhand the Developer Gauntlet!
Zone 4: Dash through the final mega Time Bubble past triple turrets, hit [MUTE-2] to shut them down, and claim the flag!

name: 拆机甲像拆盲盒
subtitle: 重装守卫小Boss：先过盲盒车间，再断电线、削肩甲、炸胸口
trollQuote: 拆盲盒最怕拆出隐藏款重装机甲！记住本喵的售后拆机口诀：一砍脚底电线、二削两边肩膀、三塞高爆炸弹轰开胸甲——包教包会喵！
trollQuoteEn: Unboxed a Secret-Edition Heavy Mech! Follow the 3-step warranty voiding guide: 1) Cut the floor WIRE, 2) Slash the shoulders, 3) Bomb/slash the chest core!
clearText: MECH UNBOXED：重组机甲被你拆成了一地废铜烂铁。
clearTextEn: MECH UNBOXED: You dismantled the Reassembly Mech down to its last bolt.
hintSteps: 盲盒车间一区：三个并排宝箱里左边是真问号补给、右边是贪婪宝箱怪！斩除宝箱怪或跳过它，关闭『UNBOX_ERR』报错弹窗。
盲盒车间二区：挥剑净化恶魔假存档碑，先开火打绿【叛变弹簧】跃过双液压冲锤走廊进入机甲拆解车间（独立存档点）。
Boss一、二阶段：先击亮地面连着发光电缆的【WIRE】电源节点破除正面重甲挥剑重创；二阶段跳上左右高台躲低空波继续挥剑削肩！
Boss三阶段决胜：拾取左侧高台刷新的【高爆炸弹】投向Boss（或贴身重剑猛劈）震碎胸口重甲，补刀击败重组机甲解锁专属成就！
hintStepsEn: Workshop 1: Watch out for the Mimic Chest hiding beside the supply block! Close the [UNBOX_ERR] popup's top [X] bar to advance.
Workshop 2: Slash the horned Traitor Save to purify it, calibrate the Betrayal Spring green, and vault over the twin Pistons to the Arena Checkpoint.
Boss Phases 1–2: Hit the floor [WIRE] node first to drop Phase 1's shield, then use the side platforms in Phase 2 to dodge low shockwaves and slash!
Boss Phase 3: Grab the Bomb on the left ledge (auto-refills if missed!) to crack its chest armor and finish the Reassembly Mech!

objs.text: 机甲保修贴 · 撕毁无效

name: 烤肉架上的冷却诈骗
subtitle: 第一块冰垫头顶悬着偷袭锤，最后借500公斤毒奶直坠冰窖
trollQuote: 被熔炉热浪烤得冒烟，看见第一块蓝汪汪的冷却台就扑过去？啪叽——头顶压顶锤正好给你盖个章！想进地下冰窖还得靠千斤坠毒奶喵！
trollQuoteEn: Sizzling at 90% Heat and diving onto the first Cooling Pad—right under an Ambush Crusher?! Bait the crusher first, and eat the 500KG Heart at the end to sink through the updraft!
clearText: CHILLED PERFECTION：外焦里嫩之前精准完成了冰镇退烧。
clearTextEn: CHILLED PERFECTION: You beat the furnace scam and dived into the cryo-vault.
hintSteps: 一区（热浪借力与冷却诱饵）：红色喷口喷发上升热浪可托举你上高台，但同时累加过热条；高台第一块蓝色冷却垫正上方藏着【压顶砖】，先轻探一步骗它砸下再踩冷却垫退烧！
二区（空中关弹窗降温）：借第二股热浪跃起击破『HEAT_404』报错弹窗【X】，落在后方真冷却台上清零热量。
三区（背身跨炉与反扇巨掌）：背身踏过熔炉上方的【害羞砖】，挥剑反扇程序员巨掌轰开隔热闸门。
四区（500KG毒奶突破上升热风井）：真终点藏在狂暴上升风井正下方的冰窖里！正常体重会被吹飞撞顶刺，故意吃下【500KG♥毒奶爱心】即可顶风沉入地窖摘旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Erupting Heat Vents lift you high while filling your Heat Meter—bait the Ceiling Crusher above Cooling Pad #1 BEFORE stepping in to cool off!
Zone 2: Ride the second thermal plume to close the [HEAT_404] popup's top [X] bar and land on the safe Cooling Pad behind it.
Zone 3: Moonwalk across the Shy Blocks and slap back the Developer Gauntlet with [U] to open the blast door.
Zone 4: The real Goal Flag sits at the bottom of an upward wind shaft! Eat the [500KG♥] Trojan Heart so your heavy boots sink right through the updraft into the vault!

objs.text: 吃500KG毒奶沉入风井地窖夺旗！
objs.textEn: EAT 500KG HEART TO SINK DOWN THE SHAFT!

name: 三路攻城·真假圣坛
subtitle: 上路害羞圣坛藏记忆碎片，中路和平白鸽，下路叉车蹦迪——任破两路即破城
trollQuote: 嫌单线闯关不够坑？上路大眼害羞砖配穿墙幽魂守着记忆碎片，中路和平白鸽盯梢禁开枪，下路暴躁叉车配逃跑砖——三条坑人路线任选两条破阵喵！
trollQuoteEn: Three troll siege lanes—pick ANY TWO! Top lane guards the ★Memory Shard with Shy Blocks & Wisps, Mid lane enforces a Peace Dove ceasefire, and Bottom lane surfs Forklifts!
clearText: SIEGE COMMANDER：三路诡阵被你谈笑间破开。
clearTextEn: SIEGE COMMANDER: You outsmarted the tri-lane fortress siege.
hintSteps: 攻城前哨：净化恶魔假存档后自由选择上、中、下三路进攻——只需打亮三路末端青色供能塔【PYLON-1/2/3】中的【任意两座】即可开启东侧汇合总闸！
上路（★记忆碎片圣坛线）：乘穿梭板配合背身【害羞砖】登上水晶圣坛，用魔剑斩除穿墙幽魂拾取【★裂界记忆碎片】并击亮【PYLON-3】。
中路与下路：中路在【核平白鸽】视野内收剑安静走过停火门后再打亮【PYLON-2】；下路踩叉车顶跳过逃跑地砖打亮【PYLON-1】。
终段城塞：穿过汇合总闸后反扇程序员巨掌，斩破守门重甲巨蟹即可摘下真旗！
hintStepsEn: Siege Outpost: Purify the Traitor Save, then pick ANY TWO of the Upper, Middle, or Lower lanes—activating any 2 of [PYLON-1/2/3] opens the East Siege Gate!
Upper Lane (★Memory Shard): Ride the shuttle and moonwalk across Shy Blocks onto the Crystal Altar; slash the Wisp with [U] to claim `shard_69` and hit [PYLON-3]!
Mid & Lower Lanes: Walk peacefully past the Mid-lane Peace Dove before hitting [PYLON-2], or bounce off the Lower-lane Forklift over the Runaway Floor to hit [PYLON-1].
Citadel Finale: Pass the unlocked Siege Gate, slap back the Developer Gauntlet, and defeat the Guardian Mech-Crab to claim the flag!

objs.text: 三路任破2塔开门 | 顶层★记忆碎片

name: 机械统御者
subtitle: 第七章统御Boss：乘托举巨掌越熔炉，双肩断电加镜面折射绝杀
trollQuote: 看这只从岩浆池底下升起来的赛博巨掌没？这次它不扇你耳光，是本喵派来托你上王座大厅的专车！拆掉钢铁王冠给你看第七章大奖喵！
trollQuoteEn: See that giant Cyber-Hand rising from the chasm? Don't be scared—this one gently palm-lifts you up to the Throne Room! Shatter the Mecha Sovereign!
clearText: CH.7 CLEARED：钢铁王冠轰然崩塌，裂界星图显现。
clearTextEn: CH.7 CLEARED: The Iron Crown falls and reveals the Fractured Corridor.
hintSteps: 王座前廊一区：开火打碎红标【FREE♥毒奶心】提纯能量护盾，借【托举型赛博巨掌】稳稳升上高台并关闭『CROWN_404』弹窗。
王座前廊二区：挥剑净化恶魔假存档碑，打哑小丑反转图腾并击败重装处刑官开启王座大厅（独立Boss存档点）。
Boss一、二阶段：先击亮左右高台【P-1】【P-2】双肩电源节点破防挥剑重创；二阶段乘顶部穿梭轨道板绕到统御者背后猛击散热弱点！
Boss三阶段决胜：跳上左侧平台向左射击【反射镜】，让超速折射剑波横穿全场轰穿终极护盾（或贴身挥动破魔圣剑），彻底粉碎机械统御者解锁第七章CG！
hintStepsEn: Corridor 1: Shoot the [FREE♥] Trojan Heart to claim a real Shield, ride the friendly palm-lifting Cyber-Hand upward, and close [CROWN_404]'s top [X] bar!
Corridor 2: Purify the Traitor Save, disable the Jester Totem, and defeat the Executioner Mech to enter the Sovereign Arena.
Boss Phases 1–2: Activate both [P-1] and [P-2] shoulder nodes in Phase 1, then ride the overhead rail shuttle behind the Boss in Phase 2!
Boss Phase 3: Bank shots off the left Mirror (or strike up close with your Magic Sword [U]) to shatter the Mecha Sovereign and unlock Chapter 7's CG!

objs.text: 王冠很重 · 借你头戴戴

name: 壁纸背面的真世界
subtitle: 前景康庄大道全是逃跑砖、假存档和食人旗，按E撕开壁纸看真相
trollQuote: 前景层铺着笔直大马路、插着存档点和大红旗，看起来像不像福利关？全——是——假——的！按 [E] 切进背景裂界层看看本喵藏在壁纸后面的真机关吧！
trollQuoteEn: Foreground looks like a freebie straight road with checkpoints and a shiny flag? ALL FAKE! Press [E] to peel back the wallpaper into the Background Layer!
clearText: WALLPAPER TORN：你再也不会相信表象世界的福利局了。
clearTextEn: WALLPAPER TORN: You saw right through the foreground facade.
hintSteps: 一区（撕开前景假象）：前景层前方的桥是逃跑砖加尖刺！站在双环终端旁射击或按【E / 切层键】切入紫色【背景裂界层】，踏着背景层暗桥安全通过！
二区（跨层躲弹窗与假存档）：前景层被恶魔假存档和 404 弹窗堵死，在共同安全台上自由按【E】交替切层，绕开壁垒并在背景层击亮【BG-OPEN】节点。
三区（前景背身砖接背景轨道）：前景层用太空步踏过【害羞砖】落上中转岛，随即按【E】切入背景层搭乘隐藏穿梭电梯。
四区（真旗在城市背面）：终点台前景层矗立着咬人的食人拟态旗与回城假旗！在末端安全台按【E】切入【背景层】即可触碰隐藏在城市背面的真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: The Foreground road is a trap! Press [E] (or shoot the Twin-Ring Terminal) on safe ground to shift into the purple Background Layer and cross the hidden bridge!
Zone 2: Shift between Foreground and Background [E] on shared decks to bypass Foreground walls and hit [BG-OPEN] in Layer 1.
Zone 3: Moonwalk across Foreground Shy Blocks onto the transfer island, then press [E] to board the Background rail shuttle.
Zone 4: Foreground's flag is a lethal Mimic Flag! Shift [E] into the Background Layer on the final deck to claim the real flag!

objs.text: 前景装修中 · 请走背面

name: 两秒前的背锅侠
subtitle: 让两秒前的自己在前景层踩住开关，本尊切去背景层反扇耳光
trollQuote: 终于不用被过去的自己追杀啦！不过本喵设计的双层联锁开关，必须一个你在前景踩踏板、另一个你在背景扇巨掌——自己跟自己打配合吧喵！
trollQuoteEn: Your 1.85s Echo is friendly today! Leave your past self holding Foreground switches while YOU shift [E] into Background to slap Developer Hands and cross bridges!
clearText: SELF CO-OP GOD：你和两秒前的自己简直是天作之合。
clearTextEn: SELF CO-OP GOD: Seamless dual-layer teamwork with yourself from 1.85s ago.
hintSteps: 一区（跨层双人踩板）：本关青色回声不伤人且可替你踩【ECHO】踏板！先在前景层踩住 1 号踏板 1 秒，立刻按【E】切入背景层踩 2 号踏板，双板同亮即开闸！
二区（清空轨迹与压顶梯）：引落前景压顶砖垫脚翻过隔墙，若节奏乱了可踩蓝色【REC】踏板一键重录回声。
三区（回声压桥+本尊过河）：在前景层高台先站住给回声留影，再切背景层走过相位桥，双踏板同步解锁三区主门。
四区（前景回声协同+背景反扇巨掌）：先在前景层左右两块 ECHO 踏板依次停顿，趁回声同步解锁大门的瞬间切入背景层挥剑反扇程序员巨掌夺旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Your cyan 1.85s Echo is harmless and presses [ECHO] switches! Stand on FG Pad #1 for 1s, then shift [E] to BG Pad #2 so both activate together!
Zone 2: Bait the Foreground Ceiling Crusher down to climb over the wall (step on blue [REC] anytime to reset your echo trail).
Zone 3: Record a pause on FG's upper pad, then shift [E] to BG's pad to synchronize the bridge lock.
Zone 4: Step across both FG ECHO pads in rhythm, shift [E] to BG to slap back the Developer Gauntlet with [U], and claim the Background Goal Flag!

objs.text: 先站前景ECHO台1秒 · 再按[E]切背景踩第2台！
objs.textEn: STAND ON FG ECHO 1S -> SHIFT [E] TO BG ECHO!

name: 牛顿棺材板跳迪斯科
subtitle: 切背景层瞬间倒吸天花板，在半空反复横跳把地刺顶刺全耍了
trollQuote: 前景往下掉、背景往天上掉！再配上一座左右脑互搏图腾和两块害羞砖，牛顿气得把棺材板掀开跟你一起跳迪斯科啦喵！
trollQuoteEn: Foreground pulls down, Background pulls UP to the ceiling! Flip [E] mid-air between floor spikes and ceiling spikes while Newton breakdances in his grave!
clearText: GRAVITY DANCER：牛顿决定把万有引力专利转让给你。
clearTextEn: GRAVITY DANCER: Newton officially handed his gravity patent over to you.
hintSteps: 一区（切层反重力上顶棚）：本关切入紫色【背景层 [E]】会自动反转重力吸附天花板！遇地面红刺切背景走顶棚，遇顶棚红刺切回前景落地面！
二区（顶棚关闭404弹窗）：倒立在背景层天花板上挥剑劈开『GRAV_404』报错弹窗，再切回前景净化恶魔假存档。
三区（打哑反转图腾过双刺峡）：先在圈外开火打哑【小丑反转图腾】，再连续两次半空切层【前景→背景→前景】S形穿梭上下尖刺阵！
四区（天花板驯服真出口）：忽略地面前景层的食人假旗，切入背景层倒立在顶棚露台上，挥剑揍服顶棚守卫并触碰背景层真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Shifting [E] into Background automatically inverts gravity onto the ceiling! Shift to BG ceiling over floor spikes, then back to FG floor under ceiling spikes!
Zone 2: Walk upside-down along the BG ceiling to slice open [GRAV_404], then shift back to FG to purify the horned Traitor Save.
Zone 3: Snipe the Jester Totem from outside its ring first, then weave [E] mid-air through the alternating floor/ceiling spike gauntlet!
Zone 4: Skip the FG floor Mimic Flag—shift [E] onto the BG ceiling promenade, clear the guard, and touch the real flag!

name: 黄牛售票传送大厅
subtitle: 前景大厅路牌全是黄牛假票，切去背景层看真站台路线图
trollQuote: 前景候车室黄牛路牌喊你进『VIP直达门』，进去就给你送回检票口排队！按 [E] 切进背景层看看墙后藏着的真检票通道和站台吧喵！
trollQuoteEn: Foreground scalper signs point straight to decoy portals that loop you back to the lobby! Press [E] into the Background Layer to find the real platform transfers!
clearText: TICKET INSPECTOR：黄牛假门一张都没骗到你的车票。
clearTextEn: TICKET INSPECTOR: Zero scalper portals fooled you today.
hintSteps: 一区（识破黄牛假门）：前景层写着『VIP直达』的一楼传送门是回大厅诱饵门！按【E】切入紫色背景层，踏上二楼隐藏检票台钻入真【A→】跃迁门！
二区（检票员宝箱怪与B门）：斩除站台伪装的宝箱怪，关闭背景层『TICKET_404』报错弹窗，进入真【B→】跨层传送门直达三号月台！
三区（背身天桥换乘）：在前景层用太空步跨过两块【害羞砖】，反扇拦路的程序员巨掌开启终段月台。
四区（C门跃迁真终点）：忽略地面食人拟态旗，切入背景层钻入高台【C→】终极跃迁门，稳稳降落在封闭贵宾室摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Foreground's ground-floor 'VIP' portal just loops back to spawn! Shift [E] into Background, climb the hidden mezzanine, and enter the real [A->] portal!
Zone 2: Slay the Mimic Chest inspector, shift [E] to Background to slice open [TICKET_404], and warp through real Portal [B->]!
Zone 3: Moonwalk across the Foreground Shy Blocks and backhand the Developer Gauntlet with [U] to open Platform 3.
Zone 4: Ignore the ground-level Mimic Flag—shift [E] to Background, take high Portal [C->], and warp into the sealed VIP vault for the real flag!

objs.text: VIP直达终点门 → 绝不退票！

name: 昨日危桥，明日凶宅
subtitle: 前景过去层有白鸽盯梢，切去背景未来层拔剑砍怪再切回来过门
trollQuote: 前景『过去层』飞着核平白鸽不准亮剑，可前面又堵着重甲怪怎么办？按 [E] 切去没有白鸽的『未来层』痛快砍完，再切回过去层装好人过和平门呀喵！
trollQuoteEn: A Peace Dove forbids fighting in the Foreground 'Past', while monsters block the Background 'Future'! Shift [E] to Future to fight freely, then shift back to Past as an innocent pacifist!
clearText: TIME ALIBI：你在未来层打完了架，回过去层照样领好人卡。
clearTextEn: TIME ALIBI: Fought in the Future, walked through the Past with a clean pacifist record.
hintSteps: 一区（过去危桥与未来垫脚石）：前景『过去层』桥梁完整但高墙拦路，切入紫色『未来层 [E]』利用已塌落的石墩阶梯翻越高墙！
二区（跨层不在场证明）：前景层有【核平白鸽】严禁动武！先按【E】切入背景未来层痛快挥剑斩除机甲并击亮【FUT-KEY】（顺路可上顶台拿★记忆碎片），再切回前景层安静走过敞开的和平闸门！
三区（时间泡双层电梯）：在前景层净化恶魔假存档，切入未来层踏进黄金【时间泡】搭乘慢速穿梭电梯跨过深渊。
四区（驯服未来真旗）：忽略前景过去层的回城假旗，切入背景未来层挥魔剑【U】揍服食人拟态旗即可完美通关！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Foreground ('Past') has an intact bridge blocked by a tall wall; shift [E] into Background ('Future') where fallen rubble forms a staircase over it!

Zone 2: A Peace Dove watches Foreground! Shift [E] into Background to freely slash the Mech-Knight, hit [FUT-KEY], and grab the ★Memory Shard, then shift back to Foreground to stroll through the Peace Gate!
Zone 3: Purify the Traitor Save in Foreground, then shift [E] to Background and use the Time Bubble to board the rail elevator.
Zone 4: Skip Foreground's warp-trap flag—shift [E] to Background and tame the Mimic Flag with one Sword Slash [U]!

objs.text: 前景有白鸽禁武 · 按[E]去背景层开打！
objs.textEn: DOVE IN FG! SHIFT [E] TO BG TO FIGHT!

name: 薛定谔的玻璃栈道
subtitle: 全息假玻璃一踩就漏，大眼害羞砖一看就虚——先开枪验桥再走太空步
trollQuote: 欢迎挑战裂界网红玻璃栈道！一半是没装底板的全息假玻璃，另一半是被你盯着看就害羞消失的大眼砖——不先发剑波验货就敢往上冲喵？
trollQuoteEn: Half the bridge is holo-fake glass, and the other half is Shy Eye Blocks that vanish when watched! Test-fire shots first, moonwalk second, and shift [E] mid-bridge!
clearText: GLASS INSPECTOR：全息假玻璃与害羞砖都瞒不过你的火眼金睛。
clearTextEn: GLASS INSPECTOR: Every holo-pane and Shy Block bowed to your footwork.
hintSteps: 一区（开火验真假玻璃）：真玻璃有厚白双边框与底影，全息假玻璃一发子弹/剑波试射就会爆出红光现原形！验明真玻璃稳步跃过。
二区（玻璃+害羞砖混编）：先验出真玻璃站稳，再起跳半空转身背对【害羞砖】落台；遇前景死路立即按【E】切入紫色背景层绕行！
三区（长脚逃跑桥与404门）：在背景层关闭『GLASS_404』报错弹窗，切回前景假跳骗【逃跑地砖】归位并净化恶魔假存档。
四区（反扇巨掌与双层假旗）：挥剑反扇程序员巨掌破开终门，避开前景层的食人拟态旗，切入【背景层】踩实真玻璃摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Real glass has thick white bevels & shadows; test-fire bullets to expose pink Holo-Fake panes before jumping!
Zone 2: Combine glass-testing with mid-air turn-arounds on Shy Blocks, then press [E] to bypass Foreground barriers via Background!
Zone 3: Close [GLASS_404] in Background, shift back to Foreground to bait the Runaway Floor, and purify the Traitor Save.
Zone 4: Slap back the Developer Gauntlet with [U], skip Foreground's Mimic Flag, and shift [E] to Background to walk across real glass to the goal!

objs.text: 先开火试探玻璃真假 · 厚白边才是真货！
objs.textEn: SHOOT GLASS TO TEST · THICK RIM IS REAL!

name: 三个臭皮匠顶个哥查德
subtitle: 1.7秒和3.4秒前的两个你同时打工，先校准弹簧再三人合唱开门
trollQuote: 一个哥查德不够坑，本喵直接给你排了三个班次！1.7 秒前和 3.4 秒前的两道回声全归你指挥——要是弹簧忘了先校准，三个你整整齐齐飞坑里喵！
trollQuoteEn: Why troll one Godchard when three can fail in unison?! Choreograph your 1.7s and 3.4s Echoes across three switches—and calibrate that spring BEFORE recording!
clearText: TRIPLE HARMONY：三个时空的哥查德同时踩响了胜利节拍。
clearTextEn: TRIPLE HARMONY: Three Godchards across time unlocked the vault in unison.
hintSteps: 一区（三人同踩三踏板）：本关拥有 1.7s 与 3.4s 两道无伤协作回声！依次在 1号踏板停 1.2 秒 → 2号踏板停 1.2 秒 → 站上 3号踏板，三个你同时就位立即破门！
二区（先校准弹簧再录高台轨迹）：先开火把紫红【叛变弹簧】校准变绿，再踩蓝色【REC】重录轨迹：先弹上二楼踩高空踏板，再落下踩地面踏板！
三区（双层三踏板接力）：前景层连踩两座 ECHO 踏板后按【E】切入背景层踩住第三座踏板，跨层三机同步解锁深渊光纤桥。
四区（毒奶识破与驯服食人旗）：开火击碎红标【FREE♥毒奶心】获赠真护盾，斩破重甲坦克后挥魔剑【U】揍服食人拟态旗过关！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: You have TWO friendly Echoes (1.7s & 3.4s)! Pause ~1.2s on Pad 1, ~1.2s on Pad 2, and stand on Pad 3 so all three Godchards press simultaneously!
Zone 2: Shoot the Betrayal Spring green FIRST, tap [REC], bounce onto the upper ECHO pad for 1.2s, then drop onto the lower ECHO pad!
Zone 3: Pause on both Foreground ECHO pads, then press [E] into Background to stand on the third pad and power the fiber bridge.
Zone 4: Shoot the [FREE♥] Trojan Heart for a Shield, defeat the Mech-Tank, and slash [U] the Mimic Flag once to tame it!

objs.text: 双回声就位：依次在1→2→3号台各停1秒！

name: 裂界鬼打墙大迷宫
subtitle: 前景死胡同是全息假墙，背景报错框后藏跃迁门，托举巨掌送你上房顶
trollQuote: 在裂界迷宫里绕了三圈还在原地打转？前景堵路的墙是假的、背景报错框劈开藏着真传送门、最后那只大手是托你上天台的电梯喵！
trollQuoteEn: Lost in the Fracture Maze?! Foreground dead-ends are fake walls, Background's 404 popup hides Portal B, and the giant Cyber-Hand lifts you to the rooftop flag!
clearText: MAZE BREAKER：非欧几里得鬼打墙被你拆穿了底裤。
clearTextEn: MAZE BREAKER: You dismantled every non-Euclidean illusion in the maze.
hintSteps: 一区（磁盾挡炮穿假墙）：先切换蓝极磁块挡住狙击炮塔激光，前景看似死胡同的紫光高墙是【全息假墙】，直接穿墙而过！
二区（背景层劈弹窗进B门）：别进前景层的诱饵回城门！按【E】切入背景层劈碎『MAZE_404』报错弹窗，钻入其背后隐藏的真【B→】跃迁门！
三区（喂宝箱怪+磁块自动压板）：拾取高台炸弹投喂【贪嘴宝箱怪】开路，再切换二号磁极让金属块自动滑到【ECHO】踏板上永久压住门锁！
四区（托举巨掌登顶夺真旗）：忽略一楼咬人的食人假旗，站上右侧【托举型赛博巨掌】让它把你稳稳托上迷宫屋顶摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Pull the Blue Polarity Block to block the Sniper Turret, then walk right through the glowing Foreground Fake Wall!
Zone 2: Ignore Foreground's decoy portal—shift [E] into Background, slice open [MAZE_404], and enter hidden Portal [B->]!
Zone 3: Feed a Bomb to the Mimic Chest, then toggle Polarity Node #2 so the magnetic block slides onto the [ECHO] pad and holds the gate open!
Zone 4: Skip the ground-floor Mimic Flag—step onto the palm-lifting Cyber-Hand to rise up to the rooftop Goal Flag!

name: 强迫症猎人诱捕器
subtitle: 三枚亮晶晶记忆碎片每枚都绑着连环坑，不贪能活，全拿封神
trollQuote: 知道你们全收集强迫症看见『★SHARD』就走不动道！本喵特意给三枚记忆碎片分别配了宝箱怪、逃跑砖和500KG狂风井——敢全拿本喵敬你是条汉子喵！
trollQuoteEn: Completionists can't resist shiny ★Memory Shards! Each of the 3 shards here is rigged with its own bespoke trap—outsmart them all or take the tricky low road!
clearText: SHARD CONNOISSEUR：本喵的诱捕夹被你连饵带夹全端走了。
clearTextEn: SHARD CONNOISSEUR: You cleared the bait AND pocketed the shards.
hintSteps: 一区（1号碎片·压顶梯与宝箱怪）：引落压顶砖垫脚登上二楼圣坛可拿 1 号★记忆碎片（注意旁边宝箱是宝箱怪，挥剑两刀斩除）！
二区（2号碎片·双层害羞栈道）：切入紫色【背景层 [E]】背身踏过【害羞砖】即可摘取悬浮在裂界半空的 2 号★记忆碎片。
三区（3号碎片·停火白鸽与校准弹簧）：先在核平白鸽视野内收剑安静通过和平门，过了门再开火打绿叛变弹簧飞取高空 3 号★记忆碎片！
四区（反扇巨掌与真旗收官）：净化假存档后反扇程序员巨掌破开终门，挥剑击败处刑机甲即可稳稳摘旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1 (Shard #1): Bait the Ceiling Crusher down to climb onto the upper ledge, slay the Mimic Chest guard, and grab `shard_79_1`!
Zone 2 (Shard #2): Shift [E] into Background and moonwalk across the Shy Blocks to snag `shard_79_2` mid-chasm.
Zone 3 (Shard #3): Keep weapons holstered past the Peace Dove gate first, then calibrate the Betrayal Spring green to leap up to `shard_79_3`!
Zone 4: Purify the Traitor Save, slap back the Developer Gauntlet with [U], and defeat the Executioner Mech for the real flag!

name: 裂界核心
subtitle: 第八章统御Boss：破开玻璃与弹窗幻阵，回声锁盾跨层斩碎核心
trollQuote: 欢迎来到像素之墙的裂缝！裂界核心会在前景和背景之间反复横跳躲你的剑——最后记得喊两秒前的自己按住前景开关，你切去背景层绝杀喵！
trollQuoteEn: Fracture Core phases between Foreground & Background! Track its solid layer in Phase 1, then leave your Echo holding Foreground switches in Phase 3 while you strike in Background!
clearText: CH.8 CLEARED：像素壁垒破碎，幕后黑手 NULL 现身。
clearTextEn: CH.8 CLEARED: Beyond the shattered pixel wall, Administrator NULL watches.
hintSteps: 裂界前廊一区：开火验明真玻璃与背身【害羞砖】，切入背景层关闭『CORE_404』报错弹窗。
裂界前廊二区：挥剑净化恶魔假存档碑，与 1.8s 协作回声同踩双踏板解封核心大门（独立Boss存档点）。
Boss一、二阶段：观察裂界核心在哪一层凝实（半透明态无敌），按【E】切至同层挥剑猛攻；二阶段利用双层高台切换躲避跨层波并抓绿光窗口输出！
Boss三阶段决胜：先在前景层依次踩亮左右两块【ECHO】踏板让回声锁死护盾，随即按【E】切入【紫色背景层】挥剑斩碎裂界核心解锁第八章CG！
hintStepsEn: Corridor 1: Test-fire the Glass Panels, moonwalk the Shy Block, and shift [E] into Background to close [CORE_404]!
Corridor 2: Purify the Traitor Save and sync with your 1.8s Echo on the twin switches to unlock the Core Chamber.
Boss Phases 1–2: Shift [E] to match whichever layer Fracture Core solidifies in during Phase 1, and strike during green vulnerability windows in Phase 2!
Boss Phase 3: Step on both Foreground [ECHO] switches so your Echo locks the shield, then immediately shift [E] into Background to land the finishing slash!

name: 逃票者的幽灵专列
subtitle: 候车月台自己长脚跑路，列车终点站竟是食人旗焚化炉——记得半路跳车
trollQuote: 买不起车票还想蹭本喵的时钟专列？站台地板见你就跑，而且末班车的终点站是食人旗火葬场哦——聪明人都在半路蓝色换乘门跳车啦喵！
trollQuoteEn: Trying to fare-dodge the Clockwork Express?! Even the station floor runs away from you—and the final train drives straight into a Mimic Flag! Jump off mid-ride into Portal [A->]!
clearText: FARE DODGED：你在专列冲进火葬场前一秒潇洒跳车换乘。
clearTextEn: FARE DODGED: You transferred mid-flight right before the furnace.
hintSteps: 一区（逃跑月台乘专列）：月台边缘是【长脚逃跑地砖】，先假跳骗它滑定再登上第一班轨道专列！
二区（车顶关检票弹窗）：随二号专列驶入【时间减速泡】，在慢速滑行中跃起击破『FARE_404』检票弹窗右上角【X】继续前行。
三区（半路跳车换乘真月台）：三号专列终点直通食人假旗与尖刺！务必在专列经过高空【蓝色 A→ 跃迁门】时果断跳车进门（避开左侧红色回站诱饵门）！
四区（节拍闸与反扇列车长）：穿过绿色窗口节拍闸，挥剑反扇列车长赛博巨掌即可抵达中央车站真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Feint-hop to bait the Runaway Platform at the station edge, then board Clockwork Train #1!
Zone 2: Ride Train #2 into the golden Time Bubble and jump to strike the top [X] bar of the [FARE_404] ticket barrier!
Zone 3: Train #3's end-of-line is a Mimic Flag trap! Hop off mid-ride onto the upper platform and enter blue Portal [A->] (skip decoy Portal X)!
Zone 4: Dash through the Beat Gate's green window and backhand the Conductor's Gauntlet with [U] to reach the true terminal!

name: 假暂停！世界还在偷袭
subtitle: 时钟节点只冻踏板不冻炮弹压顶锤，还得在白鸽视野外远程开枪
trollQuote: 打响时钟节点看见提示『PAUSED』就原地叉腰摆造型？人家只冻结移动平台，炮塔激光和头顶压顶锤可还在全速上班呢喵！
trollQuoteEn: Shot the Time Node and stood still thinking the whole game paused?! Only moving platforms freeze—turrets, saws, and ambush crushers are still wide awake!
clearText: SELECTIVE PAUSE：你彻底摸透了假暂停的局部说明书。
clearTextEn: SELECTIVE PAUSE: You read the fine print on partial time-freezes.
hintSteps: 一区（局部时停看时机）：金色【时钟节点】只冻结轨道移动平台 4.2 秒，炮弹与压顶锤照常运作！趁快速移动桥滑到深渊正中时开火冻住它当跳板，并提防头顶偷袭锤！
二区（白鸽视野外超远狙击）：桥上方盘旋着【核平白鸽】严禁近距离开火！站在左侧白鸽警戒圈外提前射出一发远程剑波冻住远端移动台，再收剑安静跳过去！
三区（时间泡穿弹幕+背身砖）：借时间减速泡钻过双炮塔火网，半空背身踩实【害羞砖】。
四区（冻结电梯+驯服食人旗）：打哑反转图腾，冻住升降台翻过节拍闸，最后挥剑【U】揍服食人拟态旗过关！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Time Nodes ONLY freeze rail platforms for 4.2s—turrets and Ceiling Crushers still strike! Shoot the node right as the fast shuttle centers over the gap.
Zone 2: A Peace Dove guards the chasm! Stand OUTSIDE its watch zone on the left ledge to snipe the distant Time Node, then cross peacefully without attacking!
Zone 3: Use the golden Time Bubble to weave past twin Sniper Turrets and moonwalk onto the Shy Block.
Zone 4: Disable the Jester Totem, freeze the vertical lift to clear the Beat Gate, and slash [U] the Mimic Flag to tame it!

objs.text: 时钟节点只冻移动台 · 炮弹压顶锤照砸！
objs.textEn: TIME NODE ONLY FREEZES RAILS, NOT TRAPS!

name: 多米诺拆迁办主任
subtitle: 第一排诡雷谁炸谁升天，喂宝箱怪加毒蘑菇炼弹才是持证拆迁
trollQuote: 看见一排多米诺连环雷就手痒往自己脚边扔炸弹？轰隆——拆迁办主任把自己先拆进墓碑啦！隔着防爆墙炸，再去喂饱贪嘴宝箱怪喵！
trollQuoteEn: Detonated the front Trap Chain-Bomb right at your own toes?! Stand on the high blast deck, feed a bomb to the Mimic Chest, and brew Toxic Alchemy for the inner bunker!
clearText: LICENSED BLASTER：精准定向爆破，零工伤拆平整座违建。
clearTextEn: LICENSED BLASTER: Precision demolition with zero self-detonations.
hintSteps: 一区（避开自杀诡雷喂宝箱怪）：地面第一枚连环雷带自爆反伤陷阱，切勿引爆！拾取高台炸弹直接投喂右侧【贪食宝箱怪】即可安全开门！
二区（隔墙引爆真多米诺雷链）：跳上安全防爆高台向右侧沟槽投弹，引爆三连多米诺诡雷轰塌远端重型堡垒墙（炸弹耗尽会自动补给）！
三区（以毒攻毒炼金爆破）：重温经典绝活——先吃紫毒菇挂毒，立刻撞击红骷髅花（切勿挥剑误砍红花；若误砍也会自动再生！）炼成破墙炸弹轰开内门！
四区（穿梭机空投轰门）：拾取终段炸弹搭上轨道穿梭台，在滑行途中向右侧终点石墙空投一发高爆弹，夺取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Do NOT detonate the trap chain-bomb on the floor! Grab the upper Bomb and throw it straight into the bomb-eating Mimic Chest to unlock Gate 1!
Zone 2: Stand atop the blast-shield ledge and toss a Bomb into the right trench so the domino chain-bombs breach the thick wall!
Zone 3: Classic Toxic Alchemy—touch the Purple Poison Shroom, then touch the Red Skull-Flower (don't slash it!) to brew a Bomb and blast the bunker!
Zone 4: Grab a Bomb, ride the rail shuttle across the abyss, and air-drop the bomb into the final barricade!

objs.text: 快炸脚边这颗雷秒通关！
objs.textEn: BLOW THIS FLOOR BOMB FOR FREE WIN!

objs.text: 别挥剑砍花！吃紫菇撞红花炼制炸弹！
objs.textEn: EAT PURPLE SHROOM + TOUCH FLOWER = BOMB!

name: 被1.8秒前的自己追杀
subtitle: 全程高速逃亡不能回头，最后踩反向弹簧从残影头顶倒飞进传送门
trollQuote: 1.8 秒前的你提着大宝剑在屁股后面狂追！最刺激的是最后那堵死胡同高墙——敢不敢踩反向弹簧从残影脑门顶上倒飞进单向门喵？！
trollQuoteEn: Your lethal 1.8s shadow is right on your heels! At the final dead-end wall, stomp the Reverse Spring to backflip RIGHT OVER your shadow into the escape portal!
clearText: BACKFLIP ESCAPE：那一记越过自己头顶的反向弹射帅炸了。
clearTextEn: BACKFLIP ESCAPE: Vaulting backward over your own shadow was pure cinema.
hintSteps: 一区（不停步骗锤跨坑）：1.8 秒致命残影紧咬不放！保持向右冲刺节奏：擦边引落压顶砖翻上二楼，把残影甩在下层。
二区（高速太空步过害羞桥）：跃向【害羞砖】时在空中短暂点左键背身踩实，落地瞬间继续向右起跳，绝不原地停留！
三区（时间泡内边跑边扇巨掌）：冲过时间减速泡顺手挥剑【U】反扇程序员巨掌破门（顺路高台可摘★记忆碎片）。
四区（死胡同反向弹簧倒飞越影）：冲到右侧死胡同尽头直接踩【紫红反向弹簧】，从追来的残影头顶高高倒飞左跃，落上高空平台钻入【A→】传送门直达终点！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Keep moving forward—trigger the Ceiling Crusher on the run and hop onto the upper catwalk!
Zone 2: Tap Left briefly mid-air to solidify each Shy Block, then immediately leap forward before your 1.8s shadow catches up!
Zone 3: Dash through the Time Bubble and press Sword Slash [U] in stride to backhand the Developer Gauntlet!
Zone 4: Run to the dead-end's Reverse Spring (`back_yeet`)—it vaults you backward OVER your pursuing shadow onto the upper Portal [A->] to the flag!

objs.textEn: DON'T LET PAST YOU CATCH UP

name: 打卡迟到扣光智商
subtitle: 闪亮金钟是4.5倍催命符，生锈齿轮钟才是节拍闸加时器
trollQuote: 限时倒计时一响，看见亮闪闪的大金钟就开枪打？恭喜触发 4.5 倍光速下班惩罚！人家旁边不起眼的灰齿轮钟才是真加时器喵！
trollQuoteEn: Shot the shiny Gold Clock to stop the countdown?! Congrats on triggering 4.5x Turbo Doom! Shoot the humble Gear Clocks to stop timers & widen Beat Gates!
clearText: PUNCTUAL LEGEND：踩着最后一拍打卡，全勤奖到手。
clearTextEn: PUNCTUAL LEGEND: Clocked in past every Beat Gate without hitting the gold trap.
hintSteps: 一区（别打金钟打灰钟）：关卡开启 42 秒打卡倒计时！千万别打低处闪亮的诱饵金钟（会加速 4.5 倍），跳起击碎上方【灰色齿轮钟】即可彻底解除倒计时！
二区（打爆节拍齿轮加时）：击碎二区高处的辅助节拍齿轮钟，将后续所有【节拍闸门】绿色开启窗口大幅延长 +3.2 秒！
三区（双节拍闸与反扇巨掌）：看准门顶灯条节奏连过两道节拍闸，挥剑反扇程序员巨掌并跳过长脚逃跑砖。
四区（时间泡校准弹簧越假旗）：在黄金时间泡内开火打绿【叛变弹簧】，一跃飞过地面食人假旗直落高台真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: DO NOT shoot the shiny Gold Clock (it speeds up the timer 4.5x)! Jump to shoot the upper grey Gear Clock and cancel the countdown completely!
Zone 2: Shoot the second Beat Gear Clock to extend all Beat Gate open windows by +3.2 seconds!
Zone 3: Read the overhead light bars across twin Beat Gates, backhand the Developer Gauntlet with [U], and bait the Runaway Floor.
Zone 4: Step inside the Time Bubble, shoot the Betrayal Spring green, and vault over the lower Mimic Flag onto the upper real flag!

name: 幽灵电梯与隐形加班
subtitle: 半空青框是过去电梯的残魂，先关挡枪弹窗再敲钟招魂搭桥
trollQuote: 连电梯都在996隐形加班！半空飘着的青色像素卡扣是电梯在过去留下的残影——不过时钟开关前面本喵贴了个大弹窗挡你枪口喵！
trollQuoteEn: Those cyan pixel brackets in mid-air are ghosts of past elevators! Close the 404 popup blocking your line of sight first, then ring the Time Node to solidify them!
clearText: ELEVATOR NECROMANCER：过去加班的电梯全被你召唤出来当苦力。
clearTextEn: ELEVATOR NECROMANCER: You summoned past elevators across every chasm.
hintSteps: 一区（敲钟实体化残像台）：射击金色【时钟节点】可将青色卡扣【时间残像电梯】实体化 4.6 秒！看准残像滑近岸边时开火登车。
二区（先关挡路弹窗再开电梯）：二号时钟节点被『LIFT_404』报错弹窗挡住弹道，跳上踏板先击破弹窗顶部红栏【X】，再紧接一枪唤醒双连残像电梯（上层可顺取★记忆碎片）！
三区（核平白鸽+压顶梯）：收剑安静穿过白鸽停火区，过了门再引落压顶砖垫脚翻墙。
四区（垂直残像梯登顶驯旗）：激活三号时钟节点搭乘垂直上升的残像电梯躲开电锯，登上顶台挥魔剑【U】揍服食人拟态旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Shoot the golden Time Node to solidify cyan bracket Time-Slice Elevators for 4.6s and ride across!
Zone 2: Slice or shoot the top [X] bar of [LIFT_404] first to clear your firing lane, then hit Time Node #2 to ride the twin lifts (snag `shard_86` above)!
Zone 3: Walk peacefully under the Peace Dove without attacking, then bait the Ceiling Crusher past the Peace Gate.
Zone 4: Solidify the vertical Time-Slice Lift to ascend past the Orbit Saw and tame the rooftop Mimic Flag with [U]!

name: 让子弹先歇会儿
subtitle: 剑波进时间泡会打盹悬停0.6秒，人先跳过去等自己的子弹帮你开门
trollQuote: 姜文喊让子弹飞一会儿，本喵偏让你的剑波进时间泡先睡个午觉！开完枪赶紧往前跳——等你落到断桥口，睡醒的子弹刚好替你把桥点亮喵！
trollQuoteEn: Shots entering Time Bubbles nap for 0.62s before flying on! Fire into the bubble FIRST, leap toward the unpowered bridge, and let your waking shot turn the bridge on mid-jump!
clearText: DELAYED SNIPER：你和自己打盹的剑波打出了神级时间差。
clearTextEn: DELAYED SNIPER: Impeccable timing with your napping sword waves.
hintSteps: 一区（预射延迟弹铺桥）：本关子弹触碰【时间泡】会悬停蓄势 0.62 秒再继续飞！先朝时间泡开一枪，紧接着跃过小墙——悬停弹射出恰好点亮【BR-1】光纤桥接住你！
二区（延迟弹+反射镜破后门）：朝左侧时间泡开枪后迅速跳上安全高台躲避，延迟弹撞击左侧反射镜后横穿全场击碎右侧【折射棱镜门】！
三区（延迟校准叛变弹簧）：朝时间泡射出一枪后助跑起跳，子弹醒来刚好替你把前方【叛变弹簧】校准变绿，无缝弹上高架！
四区（反扇巨掌与终极延迟锁）：反扇程序员巨掌破门，利用最后一颗时间泡延迟点亮终点桥摘取真旗！
hintStepsEn: Zone 1: Shots hitting a Time Bubble pause 0.62s before resuming! Fire into Bubble #1, hop the barrier, and your delayed shot powers [BR-1] right beneath your feet!
Zone 2: Fire left into Bubble #2 and immediately hop onto the upper deck so the delayed mirror ricochet passes safely underneath you to shatter the Prism Gate!
Zone 3: Pre-fire through Bubble #3 as you sprint so the waking shot calibrates the Betrayal Spring green right before you land on it!
Zone 4: Backhand the Developer Gauntlet with [U] and time one last delayed bubble shot to power the goal bridge!

objs.text: 子弹进时间泡悬停0.6s · 先开枪再起跳！
objs.textEn: SHOTS PAUSE IN BUBBLES · FIRE THEN JUMP!

name: 死神钟骷髅·生死飙车
subtitle: 四段式百米死神追猎：回头一剑定身3.2秒，把死神骗进时间减速泡吃灰
trollQuote: 钟表死神在屁股后面飙车追命啦！慌什么慌——回头给它一记破魔圣剑就能定住它 3.2 秒，最后把它骗进黄金时间泡里慢动作散步喵！
trollQuoteEn: Chrono-Skull is racing for your soul! Turn and slash it with your Magic Sword [U] to stun it for 3.2s, bait traps on the run, and trap it inside Time Bubbles!
clearText: GRIM OUTRUNNER：钟表死神还在时间泡里慢吞吞踩刹车呢。
clearTextEn: GRIM OUTRUNNER: You left Chrono-Skull crawling inside bullet-time.
hintSteps: 一段（0–38 回头剑定身+加时齿轮）：钟骷髅逼近时回头挥魔剑【U】可令其定身瘫痪 3.2 秒！顺路打碎辅助齿轮钟并骗过长脚逃跑砖抵达一区存档点！
二段（38–76 压顶跳板与404跨栏）：引落压顶砖翻墙、击破『RUN_404』报错弹窗【X】，乘穿梭台穿过节拍闸抵达二区存档点。
三段（76–114 时间泡困死神）：连续穿过两团大型黄金【时间泡】——钟骷髅进泡瞬间慢如蜗牛，哥查德全速走太空步跨过害羞砖！
四段（114–158 校准弹簧冲线）：打绿【叛变弹簧】飞越地面食人假旗，稳落高空领奖台摘取真旗解锁追猎成就！
hintStepsEn: Lap 1: Turn and slash Chrono-Skull with [U] anytime to stun it for 3.2s! Shoot the Beat Gear Clock and bait the Runaway Floor to Checkpoint 1.
Lap 2: Bait the Ceiling Crusher to vault the wall, close [RUN_404]'s top [X] bar, and ride the shuttle past the Beat Gate to Checkpoint 2.
Lap 3: Lure Chrono-Skull into twin giant Time Bubbles where it slows to a crawl while you moonwalk across the Shy Blocks!
Lap 4: Shoot the Betrayal Spring green to vault right over the lower Mimic Flag onto the podium Goal Flag!

name: 四重时间线篡改案
